extra.bslay_tactic_text:
Zamorak slams the floor with his hands and then smashes his wings into the ground. The impact of both deals melee damage to all targets, increasing in damage the closer they are to the impact zones.

After the initial impact, Zamorak will send a line of flames towards a random target. For each active flame, Zamorak gains a stack of Shrouded in flames, which provides a 1% damage reduction to all incoming damage.

Running over a flame will pick up a stack of Flames of Zamorak. 10 seconds after picking up the first stack, the target will explode for 500 damage per stack held and 1% of this damage will penetrate through defensive and shielding effects per stack held.

If a player enters Infernus with Flames of Zamorak stacks, the eruption will detonate instantly and increase the penetration through defensive and shielding effects to 3% per stack held.

Damage from this attack is scaled with Enrage %.

extra.cheevo_details: Find all the hidden Zygomites on Anachronia.

extra.mtxmgt_source_custom: You can obtain this as a reward from the Once Upon a Slime quest.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Fool's gold streaked with an abundant facsimile of azure from the east.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: Traditionally this gemstone is buried with its owner to be used in the afterlife.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: First discovered on the island of Waiko.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: A gemstone found in the Arc region, perhaps you could track down some easterners to locate it for you.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Tends to form in sheets, creating pleasing rectangular patterns.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: We don't condone ransacking tombs, but retrieving these is more an act of preservation than looting.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Sometimes jokingly referred to as seagull pearls.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: A crate of these gems was being transported here from the Arc region, but was lost at sea. Perhaps they could be retrieved?

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Found in coral reefs off the coast. Many divers don't come back...
extra.elrc_objective_hint: You might be able to find samples of this mineral on the sea shores.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Named so as it tends to form very sharp tooth-like shapes.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: Smuggled out by a trustworthy worker, but with the Pharaoh's eyes everywhere it's been hard to keep it secret.

extra.combatv2_ability_info: +5% hunting success rate. Auto-reapplies juju hunter potion in Herblore Habitat. Increased spawns of rarer charm sprites from Yaktwee. Teleports to hunting locations (3/day).

extra.combatv2_ability_name: Your sign of the porter is active, banking specific items, using a charge each time.
Your Crystal Shield effect will not activate for at least 60 seconds.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Thought to be the crystallised salty tears of crablets.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: A gemstone found in the Arc region, perhaps you could track down some easterners to locate it for you.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: One of the strongest and most resistant precious stones in existence.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: This gem is held by a sympathetic Menaphite guard, but they've been home ill with a strange corrupting affliction.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Said to be formed in the bellies of Aminishi spirit dragons.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: A gemstone found in the Arc region, perhaps you could track down some easterners to locate it for you.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: No one alive remembers where the name for these crystals comes from.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: Ask around town, somebody is sure to have some still in supply.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Tends to be mistaken for a horned beetle or kalphite, but only at a glance.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: This one-of-a-kind crystal was smuggled out of the Grand Library. I'm not sure who is keeping a hold of it now.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Abundant deposits in Tuai Leit's sea caves have led many sailors to their deaths.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: A gemstone found in the Arc region, perhaps you could track down some easterners to locate it for you.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: For a gemstone, it doesn't half form some weird shapes.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: All the samples were confiscated, but there might be somebody in the city with some who is willing to part with it for a price.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: This gem's brown colouration links this to Apmeken in a less than flattering way.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: This unique gemstone was rumored to have been sold on the black market to somebody in the merchant district.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: This crescent-shaped gem is colloquially known as a soulstone. The name was coined by a gnomish explorer.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: This gem is mined and exported for great profits.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: The famous cat-headed cat of Menaphos.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: Known to frequent only the most exclusive of areas in Menaphos.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Didn't appreciate the way you smashed her new home to pieces.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: Often lost in tight spaces in the tombs below Menaphos.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Loves the sea view, and loves his mummy.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: Loves the sea view.

extra.elrc_objective_desc: The descendant of great aristocats. Enjoys sunbathing on lazy weekends.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: Lives for the weekend. Praise the sun!

extra.elrc_objective_desc: Also known as 'The Micebringer'. A real anti-authoritarian.
extra.elrc_objective_hint: Has developed a successful weekly hunting ritual.

extra.task_details: There are no Tasks in this locality. Enter another locality or pin a Task from the full list.
You have completed all of the Tasks in this locality. Enter another locality or pin a Task from the full list.
You currently have no Task pinned.
extra.task_step_1: You can choose one from Achievements or Challenges.

extra.task_details: Locate and spy on penguins across the length and breadth of Gielinor.
extra.task_step_1: Talk to <col=ffffff>Larry</col> or <col=ffffff>Chuck</col> at <col=ffffff>Ardougne Zoo</col> to learn more.
extra.task_step_2: You may spy on each penguin <col=ffffff>once per week</col>, and each week they all move.
extra.task_rewards: Gives points, which can be exchanged for <col=ffffff>experience</col> or <col=ffffff>money</col>. Spotting penguins also allows you to upgrade the <col=ffffff>penguin spy device</col> and unlock <col=ffffff>cosmetic rewards</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Locate and spy on penguins across the length and breadth of Gielinor.

extra.task_details: Nurture an evil sapling to full growth, then chop and burn it down.
extra.task_step_1: Evil trees sprout around common <col=ffffff>woodcutting</col> areas and <col=ffffff>close to major paths</col>.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to <col=ffffff>spirit trees</col> to discover where the evil trees are and to learn about them. You will need to complete the <col=ffffff>Tree Gnome Village</col> quest before they will speak to you.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>Farming</col>, <col=ffffff>Woodcutting</col> and <col=ffffff>Firemaking</col> experience, material rewards and a boost to <col=ffffff>Woodcutting</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Nurture evil trees using your Farming skill until they're fully grown. Then, use Woodcutting and Firemaking to attack the trees and destroy them.

extra.task_details: Locate crashed stars across Gielinor and mine them to free their occupants.
extra.task_step_1: You can talk to <col=ffffff>Wizard Rosalina</col> on the second floor of the <col=ffffff>Wizards' Tower</col> to learn more, and spend stardust on rewards.
extra.task_step_2: Telescopes to locate the stars can be found in <col=ffffff>Varrock Palace library</col>, <col=ffffff>Wizards' Tower</col>, and the <col=ffffff>Observatory</col> (after completing <col=ffffff>Observatory Quest</col>). If you have one, you can also use a <col=ffffff>telescope in your house</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Can yield <col=ffffff>experience</col>, material rewards and a <col=ffffff>mining-related buff</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Stars containing star sprites are falling from the sky all across Gielinor. If you can manage to locate one of these rocks you can mine it to free its occupant and claim a reward.

extra.task_details: Hunt implings in the world, or go to Puro-Puro to hunt them in their native habitat.
extra.task_step_1: Entering Puro-Puro through a crop circle in a wheat field outside Zanaris will aid your impling hunting endeavours.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to the wandering impling by the Zanaris crop circle to learn more.
extra.task_rewards: Gives experience and a variety of material rewards.

extra.task_details: Use logic to locate potato seeds for harvest. Defend your flags from the rabbit horde!
extra.task_step_1: You may aid the farmers as much as you wish.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to any tool leprechaun to be transported to Farmer Winkin's Farm.
extra.task_step_3: Replacing lost flags will cost 1,000 coins or 50 points.
extra.task_rewards: Gives points which can be exchanged for seeds and experience.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: You will gain 'Vinesweeper points' which can be exchanged for many types of seeds.

extra.task_details: Perform using your Ranged, Magic and Agility skills to delight the crowd.
extra.task_step_1: You may perform in each of the activities <col=ffffff>once per week</col>.
extra.task_step_2: Completing the <col=ffffff>Some Like It Cold</col> quest unlocks a <col=ffffff>Thieving</col> performance.
extra.task_step_3: Completing the <col=ffffff>Firemaker's Curse</col> quest unlocks two <col=ffffff>Firemaking</col> performances.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>Ranged</col>, <col=ffffff>Magic</col> and <col=ffffff>Agility</col> experience and a chance of earning costume rewards.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza has come to Gielinor but unfortunately it's a little short of performers. Join in and perform using your Ranged, Magic and Agility skills to delight the crowd.

extra.task_details: Collect tears of power from the rocks beneath Lumbridge.
extra.task_step_1: Talk to <col=ffffff>Juna</col> in the caves beneath <col=ffffff>Lumbridge Castle</col> to learn more.
extra.task_step_2: You may collect tears <col=ffffff>once per week</col>, as long as you have gained a quest point or sufficient experience during that period.
extra.task_rewards: Gives experience in your <col=ffffff>lowest-levelled skill.</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Collect tears of power from the rocks beneath Lumbridge. You have limited time to move about the caves, collecting blue tears while avoiding green ones.

extra.task_details: Engage in tactical combat against your fellow commander aspirants.
extra.task_step_1: Talk to <col=ffffff>Dorian</col> or <col=ffffff>Ethar</col> in the north-west of the <col=ffffff>Void Knight Outpost</col> to learn more and take part.
extra.task_step_2: You can reach the <col=ffffff>Void Knight Outpost</col> via boat from <col=ffffff>Port Sarim</col>.
extra.task_step_3: This is a troop management game so you don't need to bring any items with you.
extra.task_step_4: You may play this minigame <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>Commendations</col>, which can be exchanged for armour and experience.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: To prepare their rookies, the Void Knights have set up a Conquest Training Facility. Command your own squad and engage in tactical turn-based combat against fellow players.
extra.group_bespoke_req: You must have completed the Conquest tutorial.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: You can also spend Void Knight Commendations on packs containing herbs, minerals or seeds.

extra.task_details: Descend into the Chaos Tunnels to kill Bork.
extra.task_step_1: You may kill Bork once per day.
extra.task_rewards: Gives Slayer experience and rare summoning charms.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Deep inside the chaos tunnels the Dagon'hai have summoned an ork by the name of Bork! Defeat Bork daily for great rewards.

extra.task_details: Test the Varrock beacon network, and keep as many beacons alight as possible.
extra.task_step_1: You may make as many attempts as you wish to light the beacon network.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to any beacon guard to learn more.
extra.task_rewards: Gives Firemaking experience and tools.

extra.task_details: Kill the Odd Old Man's undead creation.
extra.task_step_1: You may kill the Skeletal Horror once per week.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to the Odd Old Man just west of Paterdomus to learn more.
extra.task_rewards: Gives Slayer and Prayer experience.

extra.task_details: Fight against representatives of the races of Gielinor in honourable combat.
extra.task_step_1: Talk to <col=ffffff>Larxus</col> in the <col=ffffff>Champions' Guild basement</col>, south of <col=ffffff>Varrock</col>, to learn more.
extra.task_step_2: You can try out an informal fight versus a leprechaun at the <col=ffffff>Champions' Guild</col>, no scroll needed.
extra.task_step_3: Otherwise, to fight a race's champion you must find a <col=ffffff>challenge scroll</col> dropped randomly while fighting creatures of that race.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>Constitution</col> and <col=ffffff>Slayer</col> experience.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Various races around Gielinor have chosen their bravest and strongest champions to fight for them in an arena beneath the Champions' Guild. Find a challenge from one of these champions and fight them in honourable combat.

extra.task_details: Compete with fellow runecrafters to gather orbs of power.
extra.task_step_1: You can find the game at the <col=ffffff>Runecrafting Guild</col>, which itself can be found through a blue portal on the roof of the <col=ffffff>Wizards' Tower</col>.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to the staff at the <col=ffffff>Runecrafting Guild</col> to learn more about the rules of the game.
extra.task_step_3: You may play the Great Orb Project <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>tokens</col>, which can be exchanged for <col=ffffff>Runecrafting armour</col> and <col=ffffff>experience</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: In this team game you compete with fellow runecrafters to gather orbs of power. Use special wands to push and pull orbs towards your team's altar while preventing the other team from doing the same.

extra.task_details: Hold off a horde of invading beasts and destroy their portals.
extra.task_step_1: Begin the game by entering a lander at the Void Knight Outpost. You can get there via the docks at <col=ffffff>Port Sarim</col>.
extra.task_step_2: Extra difficulties for this game are unlocked at <col=ffffff>Combat Level 70</col> and <col=ffffff>100</col>.
extra.task_step_3: You may play this minigame <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives Commendations, which can be exchanged for <col=ffffff>armour</col> and <col=ffffff>experience</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: This is a combat game where as a team you must defend a Void Knight from ever-increasing hordes of enemies. Either attack the portals from which the monsters spawn, or defend the knight by preventing monsters from attacking him.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: You can also spend Void Knight Commendations on packs containing herbs, minerals or seeds.

extra.task_details: Pit yourself in combat against your fellow players to capture and return the flag.
extra.task_step_1: Travel to the waiting room, west of <col=ffffff>Yanille</col>, to learn more.
extra.task_step_2: You may play this minigame <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives tickets, which can be exchanged for <col=ffffff>armour</col> and <col=ffffff>equipment</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: This team game challenges you to assault your opponents' castle using combat, siege weapons and traps, in an attempt to steal their flag. You must do all this while defending your own team's flag.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: Castle Wars tickets can be exchanged for decorative armour and consumable items which give boosts within Castle Wars.

extra.task_details: Prosecute or defend the accused before a jury of their peers.
extra.task_step_1: You can take on your first case by talking to the <col=ffffff>clerk</col> at the <col=ffffff>Seers' Village</col> courthouse.
extra.task_step_2: You must find <col=ffffff>court summons</col> to take up more cases after this.
extra.task_step_3: If you have a summons in your inventory or bank, you will not receive any more court summons.
extra.task_rewards: Gives experience in <col=ffffff>Attack</col> or <col=ffffff>Defence</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Prosecute or defend the accused of Gielinor before a jury of their peers. Use your investigative skills to analyse fingerprints, interrogate witnesses and examine crime scenes in order to bring justice and win your case.

extra.task_details: Hack back the encroaching jungle to protect the village of Tai Bwo Wannai.
extra.task_step_1: You may play this minigame as often as you wish.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to Murcaily, on the east side of Tai Bwo Wannai, to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: You will be attacked and may be poisoned while hacking back the jungle.
extra.task_rewards: Gives favour, which can be exchanged for trading sticks used to purchase goods and access to hardwood.

extra.task_details: Fight waves of TzHaar in an attempt to reach and defeat TzTok-Jad.
extra.task_step_1: The TzHaar Fight Cave is in the <col=ffffff>TzHaar City</col> on <col=ffffff>Karamja</col>. <col=ffffff>Captain Tobias</col> sails to Karamja from Port Sarim.
extra.task_step_2: You may attempt the TzHaar Fight Cave <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>TokKul</col> (TzHaar currency) and, potentially, a <col=ffffff>fire cape</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Fight waves of TzHaar in an attempt to reach and defeat TzTok-Jad.

extra.task_details: Fight your fellow players in a brawl to be the last adventurer standing.
extra.task_step_1: You can find the TzHaar Fight Pit in the <col=ffffff>TzHaar City</col>, located deep under the volcano on <col=ffffff>Karamja</ffffff>.
extra.task_step_2: You may enter the TzHaar Fight Pit <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Victory will provide <col=ffffff>TokKul</col>, used by the TzHaar as currency. If you win there is also a chance you'll receive a <col=ffffff>hybrid armour</col> torso piece.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Fight your fellow players in a brawl to be the last adventurer standing.

extra.task_details: Traverse obstacles to gather tickets from pillars within the arena.
extra.task_step_1: You may brave the arena as often as you wish.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to Izzy No-Beard or Jackie the Fruit in the arena lobby to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: It costs 200 coins to enter the arena.
extra.task_step_4: At 20 and 40 Agility, you will be able to attempt more obstacles in the arena.
extra.task_rewards: Gives tickets, which can be exchanged for rare herbs and Agility experience.

extra.task_details: Work as a team to defeat the Penance monsters and their queen.
extra.task_step_1: Talk to Captain Cain at the Barbarian Outpost to learn more and sign up.
extra.task_step_2: You may join the assault <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives honour points - usable for upgrades within Barbarian Assault - items, or experience boosts to <col=ffffff>Mining</col>, <col=ffffff>Firemaking</col> and <col=ffffff>Agility</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Work as a team with your friends to defeat waves of monsters. Each member of the team takes on a different role to defeat the monsters using combat and traps.
extra.group_bespoke_req: You must have completed the Barbarian Assault tutorial.
extra.group_reward_bespoke:
You can also spend honour points to:
Upgrade roles to be more effective in game.
Gain double XP in Agility, Mining and Firemaking.

extra.task_details: Work with other players to collectively improve your smithing output.
extra.task_step_1: You may work the Blast Furnace as often as you wish.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to the staff at the furnace to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: While this is not a combat-based minigame, you may still take damage if you operate the pump incorrectly.
extra.task_step_4: Remember to bring sufficient ore and coal to smelt!
extra.task_step_5: Your team must collectively have 30 Firemaking, Strength, Agility and Crafting.
extra.task_step_6: In addition, if you do not have level 60 Smithing, you must pay 2,500 coins per ten minutes of using the furnace.
extra.task_rewards: Increases the rate of Smithing experience gain, and halves the amount of coal required per bar.
extra.group_bespoke_req:
You must have either level 60 Smithing, or 2,500 coins per ten minutes of using the Furnace.
You must have at least one of:
30 Firemaking to fuel to the stove.
30 Strength to pump the stove.
30 Agility to pedal the conveyor belt.
30 Crafting to fix the broken pipes.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: Using the blast furnace requires half as much coal to create bars.

extra.task_details: Rebuild the Mort'ton temple and use its powers to lay the undead to rest.
extra.task_step_1: You may perform these actions as often as you wish.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to Razmire in Mort'ton to learn more. You may require Serum 207.
extra.task_rewards: Gives experience in Prayer, Crafting and Firemaking.
extra.group_bespoke_req: You must have access to Morytania.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: Burning shades in Mort'ton can grant keys, which allow you to open chests in the tombs beneath the town.

extra.task_details: Defeat the six undead Barrows Brothers in their graves beneath Morytania.
extra.task_step_1: You may brave the Barrows as often as you dare.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to the Strange Old Man near the Barrows to learn more.
extra.task_rewards: Gives material rewards, including a chance of winning a powerful piece of armour.

extra.task_details: Disarm traps and avoid snakes as you search an ancient pyramid for treasure.
extra.task_step_1: The <col=ffffff>Pyramid of Jalsavrah</col> can be found in <col=ffffff>Sophanem</col>.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to the guardian within the pyramid, or <col=ffffff>Tarik</col> outside it, to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: This game is a <col=ffffff>dangerous area</col>. If you die while participating, you will lose your items.
extra.task_step_4: Every ten <col=ffffff>Thieving</col> levels after 21, another floor of Jalsavrah becomes accessible.
extra.task_step_5: You may attempt the pyramid <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>Thieving</col> experience and treasures which can be sold for cash.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Disarm traps and avoid snakes as you search an ancient pyramid for treasure.

extra.task_details: Avoid the sorceress' guards and steal her fruit for Osman.
extra.task_step_1: You may attempt the gardens as often as you wish.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to Osman in Al Kharid to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: The spring, autumn and summer gardens give better experience than the winter, and unlock at 25, 45 and 65 Thieving respectively.
extra.task_rewards: Crush the fruit into empty glasses and hand it to Osman for Thieving experience. Also gives some Farming experience.

extra.task_details: Practice your non-combat spells and display your pizazz.
extra.task_step_1: You may train as much as you wish in the arena.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to the staff at the arena to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: You will need to bring your own runes for enchanting, alchemy and telegrab spells.
extra.task_step_4: While you may enter the Arena at level 7 Magic, some spells require up to level 33 Magic.
extra.task_rewards: Gives Pizazz Points which can be exchanged for armour, runes and spells.

extra.mtxmgt_source_custom: This title can be unlocked by purchasing the RuneCoin donation package during May 2022 Mental Health Awareness Week.

extra.task_details: Play as hunter and hunted to gather the most power from the Fist of Guthix.
extra.task_step_1: You can find the portal to Fist of Guthix in the south of the <col=ffffff>Gamers' Grotto</col>, just north of <col=ffffff>Falador</col>.

extra.task_step_3: You may play Fist of Guthix <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>tokens</col>, which can be exchanged for <col=ffffff>armour</col> and <col=ffffff>experience-boosting equipment</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: This is a combat-based minigame that pits you against a single opponent. You must either track down and slay your opponent or evade them and gather charges for the Fist of Guthix.

extra.task_details: Use gathering skills to claim sacred clay for your team.
extra.task_step_1: You can find the portal to Stealing Creation in the north of the <col=ffffff>Gamers' Grotto</col>, just north of <col=ffffff>Falador</col>.
extra.task_step_2: Talk to the <col=ffffff>Head Mystic</col> in the Stealing Creation camp to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: You <col=ffffff>cannot</col> bring any of your own items through the Stealing Creation portal.
extra.task_step_4: You may play this minigame <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives points, which can be exchanged for<col=ffffff> experience-boosting equipment</col> and <col=ffffff>armour</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: In this game you must harvest sacred clay using Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting and Hunting. Whichever team gathers the most clay is the winner.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: You will receive Stealing Creation points, which may be exchanged for tools and armours granting bonus experience.

extra.task_details: Gather soul fragments in an attempt to destroy your opponents' avatar.
extra.task_step_1: You can find a portal to the island in the south-west of <col=ffffff>Edgeville</col>.
extra.task_step_2: Once on the island, speak with <col=ffffff>Nomad</col> or <col=ffffff>Zimberfizz</col> in the camp to learn more about the rules.
extra.task_step_3: This game is a <col=ffffff>safe area</col>. If you die while participating, you won't lose any items.
extra.task_step_4: You may join a soul war <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>zeal</col>, which can be exchanged for combat experience, charms and pets.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Join a huge team battle across an entire island, where you must gather soul fragments in an attempt to destroy the opposing team's avatar.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: You will receive Zeal, which can be exchanged for experience in combat skills, charms or slayer pets.

extra.task_details: Stand with your clan to destroy your opponents!

extra.task_step_2: Talk to the staff at the Clan Wars waiting area to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: While the requirement for this minigame is a Combat level of 48, higher Combat levels will be highly useful.
extra.task_rewards: The honour of victory.

extra.task_step_2: Talk to Aluft Gianne Jr at the restaurant in the Grand Tree to learn more.
extra.task_step_3: You will need level 42 Cooking to create every possible dish required.

extra.task_details:
Welcome to RuneScape.

You control your camera view using the arrow keys.

Pan the camera round until you can see the knight at the door of the room you are in.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
The knight, Sir Vant, has information for you.

To talk to him and find out more, click on him (or click on him and select 'Talk To' if you have a one-button mouse).
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
Sir Vant needs your help - talk to him to find out more.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
extra.task_step_1: The Hints tab offers further information that will help you complete many Tasks.
extra.task_step_2: Some Hints have a button next to them which you can click to point you to a useful place, thing or person.
extra.task_step_3: For now, simply click on Sir Vant to find out what he needs from you.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
Pick up the bronze armour and weapon from the spot where Sir Vant's squire was incinerated.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
extra.task_step_1: To pick up an object, you may right-click on it where it lies and choose 'Take', or simply left-click on it.
extra.task_step_2: Items you pick up go into your inventory.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
Wield the bronze armour and weapon you have acquired.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
extra.task_step_1: To wear an object, right-click on it in your inventory and choose 'Wear' or 'Wield'.
extra.task_step_2: Most weapons and armour can be equipped by simply left-clicking on them in your inventory.
extra.task_step_3: You can see what you are currently wearing, and what effect it has on your character, via the Worn Equipment tab on the side bar.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
Engage and kill the goblin currently looting Sir Vant's supplies.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
extra.task_step_1: You must have gathered and equipped all three pieces of the squire's gear to engage this goblin.
extra.task_step_2: Right-click on the goblin and choose 'Attack' to begin combat. You may also left-click the enemy to attack it.
extra.task_step_3: Once combat begins, you will continue to attack your opponent until one of you dies or flees.
extra.task_step_4: This goblin poses little threat, but other enemies will be considerably tougher. You can get a rough estimate of an enemy's strength by looking at the level displayed next to their name when you right-click on them.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Talk to Sir Vant again to find out what he needs you to do next.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Open the Quest Journal interface to see your current quest progress. Click on an entry in the list to see what you should be doing to progress in that quest.
extra.task_step_1: You are now on a quest to deal with the dragon. For more information, click on the Quest List tab on the side bar...
extra.task_step_2: ...and then on the Unstable Foundations entry to view your Quest Journal.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Before you go off to drug the dragon, check your surroundings. The minimap in the top-right of the screen gives a general picture; for more detail, open the world map by clicking on the globe icon.
extra.task_step_1: Check the minimap in the top-right corner of the screen to see a plan of the cellar.
extra.task_step_2: For a more complete picture of the area, click on the globe button next to the minimap.
extra.task_step_3: The world map will show you many other places once you are free of this cellar.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Set your camera view and minimap alignment back to face North, by clicking on the compass icon next to your minimap.
extra.task_step_1: Clicking on the compass arrow on the other side of the minimap from the World Map button will cause your camera and minimap to face due North.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
You must get past the dragon.

Take some drugged meat from Sir Vant's bag, then find a way to climb over the broken wall near Sir Vant into the main room of the cellar.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
extra.task_step_1: Pick up some drugged meat from Sir Vant's bag by clicking on it.
extra.task_step_2: The wall is too high to climb without aid.
extra.task_step_3: There is a plank next to the wall; click on it to pick it up.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
The wall is too high to climb without aid. Click on the plank in your inventory to select it, then on the wall to construct a ramp.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
extra.task_step_1: In your inventory, click on the plank to select it (or right-click and select 'Use').
extra.task_step_2: With the plank selected, click on the low wall to place it. Once you have placed the plank down, you will be able to climb the wall by clicking on it.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Search the cellar to locate the dragon's food bowl and put the drugged meat in it.
extra.task_step_1: Explore the cellar until you find the food bowl.
extra.task_step_2: Use the food on the bowl to aid Sir Vant with his plan (make sure to right-click and select 'Use').
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Sir Vant has joined you by the pillars. Talk to him to discover the next step of the plan.
extra.task_step_1: Sir Vant has moved; you can now find him by the wooden pillar just south-east of the dragon's nest.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
Set Sir Vant's trap by tying an oily rag around each pillar and adding a fuse.

Once you have done this, give Sir Vant a tinderbox and light the fuse on the right.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
extra.task_step_1: To rip the cloth into strips, simply left-click on it in your inventory.
extra.task_step_2: Use each cloth on the oil can to soak it in oil, then on a pillar to set in place.
extra.task_step_3: Once the cloth is in place, use the fuse on it to ready the trap.
extra.task_step_4: You can then give a tinderbox to Sir Vant by clicking on it in your inventory and using it on him.
extra.task_step_5: Once all is ready, use the tinderbox on the pillar to light the fuse, then run for cover!
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Sir Vant will need to return the squire's weapons and armour to the family. Take them off and give them to him.
extra.task_step_1: Take off your armour and weapons by opening the worn equipment tab and clicking on them.
extra.task_step_2: Right-click on the items in your inventory and choose Use, then click on Sir Vant to hand back the kit.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
The dragon's breath burned away the ladder to the surface.

Locate another way out - the man you rescued may be able to advise you.
extra.task_step_1: The ladder in the starting room is gone, but you may be able to use the ladder in the cellar of the connected house, if you can reach it.
extra.task_step_2: You'll need to exploit a weak spot in the wall between the two cellars in order to make further progress.
extra.task_step_3: Talk to Roddeck, the man who just came out of the cupboard, to seek his input.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
Use a woodcutting hatchet to clear the roots blocking the right-hand path out of the cellar.

You now have two Tasks: click on the Back button above or the Task System icon to view both, then on one of the icons displayed to find out more.
extra.task_step_1: The exit route you have chosen is blocked by thick roots. In order to clear them, you will need a hatchet; simply click on them to attempt to cut through.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details:
Use a mining pickaxe to clear the rubble blocking the left-hand path out of the cellar.

You now have two Tasks: click on the Back button above or the Task System icon to view both, then on one of the icons displayed to find out more.
extra.task_step_1: The exit route you have chosen is blocked by rubble. In order to clear it, you will need a pickaxe; simply click on the rubble to attempt to break through it.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Clearing the roots requires level 2 Woodcutting. Find a way to attain this; Roddeck may have some useful advice.
extra.task_step_1: It seems that cutting through a tangle of roots is a harder job than it looked. You'll need to get in some practice in order to be up to the task.
extra.task_step_2: On another wall nearby is a spot where weaker roots have breached the cellar walls. Click on them, or use your hatchet on them, to cut them and practice the art of woodcutting.
extra.task_step_3: Each root knole you successfully chop will yield some chippings and 42 experience. The chippings are useless to you and can be safely dropped on the floor using their right-click option.
extra.task_step_4: Gaining 83 experience from cutting the roots will allow you to reach level 2 and be ready to deal with the major root blockage.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Clearing the rubble requires level 2 Mining. Find a way to attain this; Roddeck may have some useful advice.
extra.task_step_1: It seems that smashing through solid rock is a harder job than it looked. You'll need to get in some practice in order to be up to the task.
extra.task_step_2: On the ground nearby is a spot where stone has fallen from the ceiling. Click on it, or use your pick on it, to hack at it and practice the art of mining.
extra.task_step_3: Each lump of rock you successfully shatter will yield some chippings and 42 experience. The chippings are useless to you and can be safely dropped on the floor using their right-click option.
extra.task_step_4: Gaining 83 experience from breaking the stone will allow you to reach level 2 and be ready to deal with the major rubble blockage.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Leave the cellar via the ladder under Explorer Jack's house.
extra.task_step_1: By clearing a path into Explorer Jack's cellar you have opened a route to the outside world.
extra.task_step_2: Depart up the ladder to the surface.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: Talk to Explorer Jack about the world outside.
extra.task_step_1: Explorer Jack can tell you more about the Tasks and other possible goals available to you outside. Talk to him before you go.
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.task_details: You may now leave Explorer Jack's house and begin your own explorations.
extra.task_step_1: Good luck and have fun!
extra.task_rewards: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.

extra.poh_bookcase_info: A warrior's discoveries about the tower and its creation.

extra.dom_boss_desc:
Nomad is an incredibly proud warrior. He doesn't think twice at killing others or even harvesting the souls of innocents. Probably best to not mention that he's somewhat bald.

Quest: Nomad's Requiem

Combat: As the final boss in a high-level quest he offers a horrific battle involving duplicates of himself, proximity mines, and a devastating attack from which you'd better try to hide. Plus, he replenishes his own health. He also has an attack where he teleports you into the centre of the arena, freezes you and proceeds to take away all your life points except 1.

This giant monster is a mother to the pests that plague the void knights. Big, squirmy, and covered in eyes and tentacles; it's best not to get too close!

Quest: The Void Stares Back

Combat: She spawns drones that, in turn, spawn defilers. You must keep the queen's helpers at bay so your fellow knights can stop the queen from healing herself. You need to use the special attack of Korasi's sword (provided in the arena) to stop the queen from obliterating the knights.

Probably the tallest monster ever to exist, this lumbering beast embodies destruction and decay.

Quest: Nomad's Requiem

Combat: A fearsome foe that replenishes his health from the roots that appear around the arena. Remove the roots to avoid the avatar replenishing itself and the fight taking longer than it needs to.

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: Do you hear that? Sounds like defeat
extra.dom_boss_desc:
These beasts were created by Amascut who stole the hearing, sound and sight of Apmeken in order to create the deadly trio. There's something incredibly creepy about a foe who hides their face behind a mask...

Quest: Do no Evil

Combat: Fight these three together you'll have several things to worry about. Ayuni will teleport towards you if you get too far away; attacks with melee and magic and will drain your prayer. Leeuni attacks with melee and magic and will teleport to get up close and personal should you stray too far away. Leeuni will also remove any helmet should you choose to wear one. Eruni attacks with magic and is invincible while there are any demons around (oh yes, by the way you have to fight demons at the same time).

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: Be prepared to meet your maker!
extra.dom_boss_desc:
A sweetheart of the Wise Old Man. With her love of combat she is ready to show just how mean she can be!

Quest: Love Story

Combat: During her onslaught, she teleports around to pedestals, and you should knock her off these in order to damage her. Watch out for her spawning fire. At least the Wise Old Man is there to help!

One of the most dangerous types of dagannoth, she is the daughter of the first dagannoth to terrorise the Fremennik. Through many generations they have developed a unique set of defensive and offensive abilities. Beware!

Quest: Blood Runs Deep

Combat: To start with, you'll need to hit her with Balmung (weapon provided in arena), then she will switch at random between different combat types, requiring you to use different attack styles to deal damage to her. Be prepared to use melee, ranged and magic attacks unless you fancy a very long battle. She will attack with magic, melee and ranged attacks. You'll need to remember: blue (water magic); orange (melee attacks); green (ranged attacks); brown (earth magic); red (fire magic); white (air magic).

If you don't have the normal spellbook active, it will become active when you start this battle, and will revert afterwards.

A figment of your imagination, this creature thrives on being practically impossible to injure. Its gelatinous quality means it's difficult to deal an impact. And anyone fighting it ends up all slimy.

Quest: Dream Mentor

Combat: Fights using melee only but takes a fair amount to get in a hit. At least good old Cyrisus is there to help a little.

extra.dom_boss_2_taunt: Don't let it leave this place
extra.dom_boss_desc:
These four foes feature as guardians to four diamonds used to gain entrance to a pyramid in the Kharidian desert.

Quest: Desert Treasure

Combat: You need to fight this dangerous quartet together. Damis has two versions that you must defeat and attacks with melee. Fareed will penalise anyone not wearing ice gloves, attacking with his magic fire attacks. Kamil fights with magic and will occasionally freeze you. Dessous will make use of his patented bat attack to deal magic and ranged damage, should you choose to use one of those protection prayers.

These two creatures are the stuff of (very bizarre) dreams. One of them tries very little to avoid confrontation but is incredibly tough, whereas the other is a nuisance to chase down yet can be killed with a couple of blows.

Quest: Dream Mentor

Combat: One very tough, one tricky to reach. They both attack with melee, but you'll have Cyrisus with you to help out a bit.

These chaps are so identical they must be closely related! They are of the race of sea creatures that cause havoc for the Fremennik.

Quest: Blood Runs Deep

Combat: These bad boys work as a fearsome pair. They will restore each other's health if you concentrate on one for too long. They attack with a mixture of melee, magic and ranged.

These two creatures are creations of the Culinaromancer. One's a karamel treat, the other a jelly, so if a warrior is not hungry before fighting them, they may be afterwards.

Quest: Recipe for Disaster

Combat: Karamel will attack you with melee and mage attacks, reacting to the protection prayers you have active. She will also freeze you occasionally. The gelatinnoth mother works much like dagannoths, switching between the following states for you to attack by: blue (water magic); orange (melee attacks); green (ranged attacks); brown (earth magic); red (fire magic); white (air magic). She uses ranged attacks. Tasty.

If you don't have the normal spellbook active, it will become active when you start this battle, and will revert afterwards.

An enormous black demon, a creature of the underworld and altogether evil being. If he doesn't slash his enemies to pieces with his claws, they're likely to succumb to his vicious magic.

Quest: Legend's Quest

Combat: The huge black demon will attack with magic unless you run in and attack close range, at which he will switch to attack with his claws.

This amorphous being is one of Guthix's guardians set to protect the Stone of Jas. He is unlike any creature in the world since he is able to alter his own body into shapes, calling upon worldly elements to perform deadly attacks.

Quest: While Guthix Sleeps

Combat: He's wise to prayer types, so prepare your attacks carefully. He attacks with melee, ranged and mage attacks.

This big, lean, green killing machine is hardly friendly. Like all demons this one exists to slice its enemies to pieces with its claws or damage them with its magic powers.

Quest: Monkey Madness

Combat: The demon attacks with a mixture of melee and magic and will alter its attacks based on any protection prayers you use. There are no gnomes to help you out this time!

A man with a deep history, he lived many years ago in the fourth age. He was pivotal in the defence of Varrock against a zombie invasion summoned by the Mahjarrat Zemouregal. How can someone bring themselves to kill him?

Quest: Curse of Arrav

Combat: Arrav will heal himself twice before he dies and, unlike during your first encounter with him, in the tower this image of him will most certainly die. He attacks with his sword and basic melee.

This frosty fellow is making a return from the frozen fortress of Ghorrock to remind warriors of his icy grip.

Quest: The Temple at Senntisten

Combat: This chilly demon fights with ranged and magic attacks. He also will occasionally freeze you. Might require some careful use of the protection prayers, assuming you have them available to you!

Does this beast really exist? Only in our imaginations! The writhing blob with eyes feeds on people's insecurities and hits them with doubts.

Quest: Dream Mentor

Combat: The Inadequacy has aggressive ranged and melee attacks but also spawns doubts to deal you extra damage. At least Cyrisus is there to help a little.

Now that's a very big blue bird! It's swift and deadly and attacks from above unlike most other creatures likely to be found in Gielinor.

Quest: My Arm's Big Adventure

Combat: This bird of epic proportions will use several types of attack. Occasionally it will knock you back, stunning you. It pecks at your eyes with its melee attack and throws boulders to deal ranged damage.

Arrg is a giant troll, named after the sound made by the first thing he ate. Arrg won't hesitate to smash his victims' bones to dust with his hammer so anyone approaching should be quick on their feet.

Quest: Troll Romance

Combat: Oh no, it's the beastly Arrg! He'll attack you with a mixture of melee and ranged as he hurls rocks into your face! Bam!

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: You my friend are about to die.
extra.dom_boss_desc:
This monstrosity is a clever machine made from various nautical objects by Mi-Gor the undead surgeon pirate. No, really...

Quest: The Great Brain Robbery

Combat: This weird contraption will perform melee damage, but also reduces your Defence stat. He will also reduce your prayer points and turn off any active prayers.

This demon doesn't seem to mind living in a cave not too far from the Wilderness, so understandably he's not very friendly. Big, red, clawed, spiked - he is a fearsome creature.

Quest: Family Crest

Combat: Chronozon will simply punch you, but in order to defeat him you need to cast one of each of the 4 elemental blast spells (runes provided in the arena - don't waste them!).

If you don't have the normal spellbook active, it will become active when you start this battle, and will revert afterwards.

A really big chicken by any standards, she also has one overriding character trait: she's evil. At least that's what people say about her. Maybe she's just misunderstood.

Quest: Recipe for Disaster

Combat: Be prepared for her magic attack. Other than that, try to avoid being pecked to death.

These evil machinations of the Culinaromancer could only be created by someone obsessed with food. Three 'things' are made from loads of hot cakes, bananas and sweets. Beyond not dying, most people struggle not to take a sneaky bite of one of them.

Quest: Recipe for Disaster

Combat: A deadly trio. Flambeed is a fiery foe and you'll need to be wearing ice gloves when attacking to hold on to your weapons. He attacks with melee and magic. Agrith-Na-Na fights with magic and will occasionally teleport you face-to-face. Dessourt deals a mixture of melee, ranged and magic attacks and will occasionally teleport straight to you if you wander (or flee) too far away.

It's giant. It's scaraby. What else does anyone need to know? If one looks closely enough they'll spy Kaleef's Keris dagger - a weapon crafted to destroy any one who should worship Scabaras.

Quest: Contact!

Combat: The scarab is a mighty foe by himself, but he'll also summon locust riders, mages and rangers to fight by his side. The giant scarab himself attacks with a mixture of melee and ranged while his helpers will set upon you with a mixture of all corners of the combat triangle. The giant scarab will also poison you if you're fighting from a distance.

The most brutal guard dog of all time. If his red eyes and horns wouldn't worry a burglar, not much else probably could!

Quest: Fight Arena

Combat: Woof! Attacks with melee combat, close range. You could get up close and kill him quickly, or stay a safe distance to conserve health.

Born a Fremennik, he'll die a Fremennik as he puts people to the test of their combat prowess. He doesn't like it when people look him straight in the eyes for too long.

Quest: Fremennik Trials

Combat: This aggressive warrior has four forms that he will go through, each more dangerous than the next. He attacks only with melee so hopefully you can easily beat him.

He's the avatar of the Arzinian of Bordanzan. This being was created with one goal in mind - that of protection and it doesn't hold any conflicting emotions or agendas so fights with true determination.

Quest: Between a Rock

Combat: This holy avatar will fight you using fire-based magic. This time around the amount of gold ore you're carrying won't make a difference. It's on the tower's terms and not his!

This ugly looking giant is simple in mind, but aggressive and unyielding. He's sporting a rather fancy hair-do.

Quest: Holy Grail

Combat: This spiky-haired guy will try to slash you with his sword.

This skeletal Mahjarrat is one of the youngest of his race. He doesn't seem to have a guilty conscience about kidnapping rich people to fight in his arena, so he probably won't worry about fighting dirty.

Quest: Fight Arena

Combat: He starts off small and ugly, but when you kill his first version you'll be confronted with a larger, deadlier and, quite possibly, uglier version of the Mahjarrat man. He attacks with melee.

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: Give up! You don't stand a chance!
extra.dom_boss_desc:
This armour-clad man is an elite guard from the Kinshra (a Zamorakian military order). If it was possible to see his face beneath his mask, a mixture of anger and hatred would be seen.

Quest: A Void Dance

Combat: The knight attacks with basic melee, but has the special ability of replenishing his life points when his health gets below a certain amount by draining your prayer.

Like most trolls, Dad was named after his first attempt to eat his own father. Like a giant rock, there's not a great deal of intellect there, but some impressive might. You've been warned.

Quest: Troll Stronghold

Combat: As well as bashing your brains in with melee combat, Dad has an attack that will hit through pretty much any defence, knocking you back a few paces.

The guardian of the rare dramen tree, the spirit exists as a guardian to the tree; wood of which is key for any wanting to travel to the plane of Zanaris.

Quest: Lost City

Combat: Now you can show the spirit how tough you are with more than an axe! (No, you can't hide behind mushrooms to make it easier.)

This big demon came to Gielinor in one of the early ages and is an ancient being with a great wealth of experience in battle.

Quest: Shadow of the Storm

Combat: Watch out! Agrith Naar will attack with melee and magic, switching depending upon your use of the protection prayers. Agrith Naar will also occasionally teleport you towards him, so attacking from a distance isn't always so easy. You must deal the finishing blow with Silverlight (provided in the arena).

This is the first dagannoth mother to scare those living in Rellekka; a creature that features predominantly in children's stories among the Fremennik. This nightmare of a sea creature is, unfortunately, very real.

Quest: Horror from the Deep

Combat: Is anything ever better than the original? Well, this version of the mother changes from one protective type to another in a set order. Remember, to deal damage, consider its colours: blue (water magic); orange (melee attacks); green (ranged attacks); brown (earth magic); red (fire magic); white (air magic). She attacks with melee and ranged, depending on how close and personal you wish to get.

If you don't have the normal spellbook active, it will become active when you start this battle, and will revert afterwards.

This creature has a carapace of obsidian as its initial defence mechanism. In the TzHaar language its name relates to it being an armadillo guarded by obsidian armour and they know just how deadly it can be. Any combatant needs to break through its armour while avoiding its mace-like tail before standing a chance of damaging it.

Quest: TokTz-Ket-Dill

Combat: TokTz-Ket-Dill is immune to ranged and magic and, before you start dealing any damage, you'll want to mine through its thick armour (pickaxe provided in arena). Once broken, the TokTz-Ket-Dill is weak to crushing weapons. The beast will attack with melee and occasionally stomp the ground to rain rocks on your head.

These creations are next to mindless. Following the instructions of their creators they will attack anything that comes near them unquestioningly. Their distinct colours are the only clues to their inner workings.

Quest: Spirits of the Elid

Combat: For all three golems, magic and ranged attacks are dramatically reduced. For the black golem you're best using crushing attacks; for the white golem you're best using stabbing attacks and for the grey golem you should use slashing attacks.

Treus is the guardian of the dangerous crystals in the haunted mine below the river Salve, or at least he was until he died - and now it's his spirit that lingers on. This supernatural being has the ability to possess and control objects around him. Luckily in this tower it's 'only' pickaxes any combatant has to worry about.

Quest: Haunted Mine

Combat: The more damaged Treus is the more likely he is to show his cowardly nature and run from you, fading and teleporting away. Hit him to turn him back into his true form. He attacks (when he's not running away) with melee. He is also accompanied by three possessed pickaxes.

The giant green dragon of Crandor, Elvarg was awoken on the island by an adventurer and anyone nearby soon suffered her wrath. One person she didn't kill was Melzar. A pretty unforgettable chap.

Quest: Dragon Slayer

Combat: Possibly one of the most famous dragons to ever live, Elvarg attacks with a mixture of melee and dragon fire breath. You better have a anti-dragonbreath shield with you if you want to limit the damage you receive.

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: No more meals for you, fool
extra.dom_boss_desc:
A lunatic chef that was once renowned for his culinary creations in Lumbridge Castle. His insane drive for domination soon came to light and he was imprisoned. Having broken free, he needs to be stopped before he carves someone up with that vicious looking meat cleaver he carries.

Quest: Recipe for Disaster

Combat: This twisted chef will attack with magic. Not so strong without his minions to protect him now!

The shadow is a mere fragment of Tumeken's former self. In fighting and defeating his individual parts he will no longer pose a threat.

Quest: Missing My Mummy

Combat: You'll be attacked by all 5 versions of the shadow simultaneously. They will attack with melee, but as it's a multi-way combat area you'll probably want to dispatch them quickly.

Many have heard of the phrase 'a wolf in sheep's clothing'. However, this is a man in a bear costume.

Quest: Mountain Daughter

Combat: Grrrr! Still dressed in his stinky costume, he will attack you with melee combat, trying his best to slice you up with his claws.

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: Taste the wrath of the deadliest ghost in the world!
extra.dom_boss_desc:
Is he a ghost? Is he the living dead? A bit of both, in fact. He lingers around the place of his death and preys upon weak travellers. He left his humanity behind in his former life so no-one should expect any favours.

Quest: Fremennik Trials

Combat: The angry viking with issues is out for your blood. Last time you had to try and hunt him down, but now he's here waiting for you! He'll attack with basic melee.

Tarn ventured through Morytania in the quest for the power to control the undead but, instead, came across Treus Dayth guarding this power who proceeded to see him off. This is a man with altogether sinister intentions and is best avoided.

Quest: Haunted Mines

Combat: He'll start as a horrific mutant but in killing his first form will change to a ghost. The ghost is melee but as a mutant he will perform ranged and melee alongside summoning suits of armour to attack. How rude!

This balding man is a senior member of H.A.M. and has a vicious hatred for goblins, particularly those living near his place of work at Lumbridge Castle: the Dorgeshuun. If anyone can earn the title of a 'bad guy', Sigmund can.

Quest: Chosen Commander

Combat: Seemingly to spite you as well as protect himself, Sigmund uses protection prayers against melee, ranged and magic based on how you attack him. To make things easier, you'll need to use the special attack of the ancient mace (provided in the arena) to reduce his prayer points. With the 'no ultimate abilities' handicap, you'll only have a brief time to injure him before he replenishes his prayer points.

Originally a citizen of Crandor, Melzar was chased away by Elvarg. In his incredibly intricate and over-engineered maze he went quite crazy. Once upon a time, he was determined to restore his former friends and allies to life after the massacre on Crandor, but he now appears to be more obsessed with cabbages.

Quest: Dragon Slayer

Combat: Surely you remember this mad geezer! In-between shouting random abuse, he'll cast a fire magic attack; 'zap' you; punch you; reduce your strength and summon cabbages.

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: Mmmm. I can smell your blood!
extra.dom_boss_desc:
To his mates he's known as Victor (not that he probably has many). He was a follower of Zaros before he tried to kill him in an act of allegiance to Zamorak, but when Zaros was defeated he swapped back to following Zamorak. His hobbies include preying on naive travellers that visit Draynor Manor, practicing long theatrical speeches and fashion.

Quest: Vampyre Slayer

Combat: A stake through the heart, sunlight, garlic; all items on the count's least favourite list. He attacks with melee and you need to be carrying a stake and hammer (items provided in arena) when dealing the killing blow.

This demon was summoned to destroy Varrock only to be thwarted by... a talented adventurer. Not many people know that he originated in the infernal dimensions as a demon lord. Hopefully this time around any adventurer will find it easier.

Quest: Demon Slayer

Combat: A Demon with devilish melee attacks! This demon can only be banished by dealing the killing blow with Silverlight (weapon provided in arena).

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: Face the wrath of my powerful magic
extra.dom_boss_desc:
He may be a simple-looking mage but warriors shouldn't be fooled - he is a mass murderer and shows no sympathy for his fellow man. That, combined with the fact that there are few other mortals with his command of magic, makes him a deadly man, although hopefully not to anyone in this tower!

Quest: Wanted

Combat: Despite his classic wizard fashion style, Solus simply attacks with melee using his staff. Maybe he's feeling ill.

extra.dom_boss_name: Special: Revenge of the Evil Chickens
extra.dom_boss_desc:
Some remember the day when an evil chicken appeared, and actually took a while to kill, only to find it dropped a few feathers. Some even rolled their eyes at how easy one was to kill. Many think differently when faced with an army of them.

Combat: You must fight 15 evil chickens in a multi-way combat arena without the use of any prayers. The evil chicken attacks with magic, so you will be bombarded with hits.

Quests required to play: Recipe for Disaster.

Picture the scene: It's a dark and rainy day, and you're bravely fending off a gang of low-lifes. You're battered and exhausted, but you've put up a good fight and the enemy is hurting too... Who will win. You? (The good guy). Them? (The bad guys). Go on; shake your fists at the sky then finish them off! Arghhhh!

Combat: You must simultaneously fight the following bosses: Arrav, Koschei the Deathless, General Khazard, Black Knight Guardian, The Kendal, The Black Golem, The White Golem, and The Grey Golem. Each of them will have only 20% of their life points remaining and it's up to you to finish them off.

As it's a multi-way combat arena you will be under attack by all of them. You will also have the following handicaps active: No prayers; reduced melee, range, and magic defence; poisoned; no ultimate abilities; random daze and no power-ups.

Quests required to play: Curse of Arrav, Fremennik Trials, Fight Arena, A Void Dance, Mountain Daughter and Spirits of the Elid.

Many living creatures have utilised the benefits of sticking together in groups. As the phrase goes: 'safety in numbers'. The dagannoth sentinels work together, rejuvenating each other to survive any threat, but evidently in the past grouping into pairs was not enough. Perhaps a group of six helping each other is enough to provide enough protection for the survival of the species.

Combat: You will be placed in a multi-way combat arena against six dagannoth sentinels. The sentinels use their mechanic of healing each other so you'll need to attack them all from time to time. They still work in pairs, each healing whichever sentinel is standing to its side.

Quests required to play: Blood Runs Deep.

extra.dom_boss_name: Special: No More Nomad... No More!
extra.dom_boss_desc:
For most warriors, fighting Nomad was difficult enough once, so this is one of the most difficult (one-off) battles. It's a real test of skill to beat him twice in a row without a chance to recuperate.

Combat: You will be pitched against Nomad twice in a row without the option of replenishing your inventory for food or for taking a breather. The rules will be the same as in a normal battle with no handicaps.

Quests required to play: Nomad's Requiem.

extra.dom_boss_name: Special: I Eat Dagannoths For Breakfast
extra.dom_boss_desc:
What if all the dagannoth bosses were fought in one go? Switching combat styles and surviving is no easy feat. A warrior could, in theory, defeat them using one combat style, but it would certainly be no quick battle, if possible at all!

You will be pitched against: the original dagannoth mother, the second dagannoth mother and 2 dagannoth sentinels; all at once.

If you don't have the normal spellbook active, it will become active when you start this battle, and will revert afterwards.

There are no handicaps applied.

Quests required to play: Horror from the Deep, Blood Runs Deep.

'That was tasty, *burp* excuse me!' is the response of many, having killed one too many food-based bad-guy. Many remember the final battles from Recipe For Disaster being a challenge, but fighting all the bosses simultaneously is quite difficult.

Not convinced that's difficult enough? What about with some handicaps applied as well? Disclaimer: the Dominion Tower will not be held responsible for any digestive problems resulting from this battle.

Combat: You must fight all the end bosses from Recipe For Disaster: Flambeed, Agrith-Na-Na, Dessourt, Karamel, Gelatinnoth Mother and Culinaromancer simultaneously.

If you don't have the normal spellbook active, it will become active when you start this battle, and will revert afterwards.

Various handicaps apply: no shield; no power-ups; reduced melee, mage and ranged defence; no familiar; no body armour and no ultimate abilities.

Quests required to play: Recipe For Disaster.

Some have struggled to survive let alone defeat all the bosses from Cyrisus' insecurity-infected dreams. For those that have proudly stated they defeated them all, perhaps they'll find it more difficult to simply survive for a certain period of time with little in the way of options to defend themselves.

Combat: You must survive for 5 minutes in an arena with: The Inadequacy (+Doubts), The Everlasting, The Illusive and The Untouchable. You will not have time to kill all of the creatures, so you must devote time to evading and perhaps taking out one or two of them. Food will spawn in the arena that you can run and pick up to increase your survival time.

You will also have the following handicaps applied: reduced melee, range, and magic attack and defence; no shield; no body armour; no potions; random daze; halved HP; no prayers; no food and no familiar.

Quests required to play: Dream Mentor.

extra.dom_boss_4_taunt: Let me drink my tea in peace!
extra.dom_boss_5_taunt: You're as good as dead already.
extra.dom_boss_desc:
Wouldn't it be great if you were in an arena full of bosses and your best route to victory was to blow them to smithereens with a load of power-ups? That'd show them who was boss!

Combat: You aren't allowed to go into this fight with any weapons or armour. The arena floor will be littered with the bomb power ups.

You will then be surrounded by various lower level boss monsters: Solus Dellagar, Delrith, Count Draynor, Melzar the Mad, Sigmund, Tarn Razorlor, Draugen, The Kendal, Tumeken's Shadow, Culinaromancer, Elvarg, Treus Dayth.

You have to kill them all ONLY using the powerups (and perhaps your fists if you're so inclined). The bombs will deal more damage than normal whilst in this match! If you wish, you can use Silverlight, the ancient mace, the hammer and stake to finish off Delrith, Sigmund and Count Draynor respectively (weapons supplied in the arena).

These are the only weapons you can wield in the battle. There are no other handicaps applied in this battle.

Quests required to play: Wanted, Demon Slayer, Vampyre Slayer, Dragon Slayer, Chosen Commander, Lair of Tarn Razorlor, Fremennik Trials, Mountain Daughter, Recipe for Disaster and Missing My Mummy.

extra.bslay_tactic_text:
Zamorak will send an edict symbol towards all targets in the encounter which will force them into Infernus after a short period of time and then enter his Decimate attack.

Whilst on Infernus, each target will need to escape by stepping into the symbol that matched the symbol Zamorak cast on them.

Within Infernus, a Chaos Demon will spawn for each target sent in. These demons will path towards the entry portal in an attempt to reach Zamorak. Any Chaos Demons that escape Infernus and reach the main arena will double their lifepoints and Fixate on a random target, unable to be Provoked away. Each consequtive hit will make the demons stronger.

Damage from this attack is scaled with Enrage %.

extra.bslay_tactic_text:
Zamorak will let out a burst of energy, removing all active overhead prayers. Zamorak's main target's position will be targeted with a barrage of chaos damage dealing magic damage split between targets who remain at the chosen position, or typeless damage to all targets if no one stands in the targeted area, as well as having 10% of their adrenaline drained and a adrenaline gain debuff applied.

Damage from this attack is scaled with Enrage %.

Once Zamorak hits his lifepoint cap for his current phase, he'll call forth and channel from a Chaos witch from within Infernus, also preventing any Edict pad from being charged up. Whilst channeling from this witch, Zamorak will progressivly gain more power for his Berserk phase.

Once the witch is killed, Zamorak's targets will once again have the ability to charge up an Edict by stepping on the pads.

In encounters of 100% enrage or higher, Zamorak will make a last ditch attempt to kill the player by pulling them into Infernus.

Zamorak will draw from each hexed edict symbol in a random order, building up Chaos damage whilst channelling from them. Targets can disrupt and stagger Zamorak by attacking the correct order of symbols shown in order to open up Zamorak for attack.

As Zamorak's damage window is opened up, he'll slam the floor, dealing melee damage, dealing increased damage the closer the targets are to him.

After this strike, Zamorak will deal the total amount of Chaos damage as one big hit with 50% of this damage penetrating through defensives and shielding effects, stacking with the Disintegration hex, to every target on Infernus, which will deal further AoE damage if targets are standing close to each other.

Once Zamorak's damage window is closed, he'll repeat the melee slam and Chaos Damage hit before beginning to channel from the symbols once more.

Damage from this attack is scaled with Enrage %.

extra.dom_boss_desc:
An incalculable number of creatures have been summoned from memories in the tower. As it turns out, creatures aren't exclusively drawn from memories: the fears, combat expertise and dark desires of warriors have seeped into the tower, until one horrific day when a creature was born: the Sunfreet.

Combat: The Sunfreet switches between two states: one in the air and one on the ground. While in the air, you'll want to be careful of its fierce fire-breathing, and it'll take you time to learn the pattern of its attack. While on the ground, it's at your disposal, although it fiercely attacks with its spear-like tail and flaming breath.

If you should see it inhale, be prepared to turn the other way, unless you wish to be stunned. The Sunfreet will also make a sweeping attack with its tail, for which retreat is the only sensible option. Get it close to death and you'll find it altogether more aggressive. Dragonfire shields won't help protect you.

You will also have the following handicaps applied: no power-ups, no familiars, no ultimate abilities, no prayers.

A character is born: The visual design of the Sunfreet was chosen by attendants of RuneFest 2011, a celebration of all things RuneScape. Based on the concept art and model created at the festival in London, we designed the mechanics to match. Anyone paying close attention might have noticed that the name of the beast is an anagram of 'RuneFest'. Thank you to all the warriors who voted on the design, as it was your 'fears, combat expertise and dark desires' that brought him to life!

Quests required to play: None.
