extra.pop_voyage_text: Capture a fortified sea bastion, belonging to the khan of New Heritage, near the coasts of New Heritage. It will be a useful asset.
Smuggle weapons, belonging to the khan of Khanoka, to his forces within New Heritage. Ensure you aren't caught by the authorities.
Spy on the khan of New Heritage and deliver information to the spymaster on Khanoka.
Maintain a siege on New Heritage's floating towers, located on the south-most part of the island. Make sure you're flying Khanoka's colours.
Sabotage the ships docked in New Heritage's grand port to ensure we remain competitive.
Bixi the stone tortoise has been spotted near the gates of New Heritage. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
Befriend the khan of Khanoka's son, situated in the Palace of Khans, who may well prove to be a useful ally.
Maintain a siege on the Jade Gates located on Khanoka's frontier. Make sure you're flying New Heritage's colours.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with the khan of Khanoka for quantities of stainless steel in exchange for New Heritage's secrets.
Form an alliance with the khan of Khanoka. This should secure our continued access to the area. At least until we break the treaty.
Board the khan of Khanoka's prize ship, the Green Star, and claim the goods on board.
Smuggle a dangerous soothsayer, loyal to the khan of New Heritage, to the heart of Khanoka's capital city. Ensure you aren't caught by the authorities.
Spy on the khan of Yamada and deliver information to his brother in New Heritage.
Set up a stainless steel factory to exploit the natural reserves and produce of Yamada Island.
Intercede in a fight between a fleet of Blazing Lantern ships and Golden Katana schooners.
Few have ever sailed to the Reef of Perpetual Storms, north of Yamada, and lived to tell the tale. Perhaps your captain can last the distance.
There is an oversupply of stainless steel in the markets of Yamada Island. Collect some whilst prices are low.
Your navigator has found rich resources south of Yamada Island, near the Sea of Knives. Send a ship to locate and retrieve them.
Smuggle an assassin to the docks of Flou Tar-Shei. The khan of Yamada Island wishes to have a man stationed there. Ensure you aren't caught by the authorities.
The Jade Leviathan has been spotted near Flou Tar-Shei. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
Explore the sunken city beneath Flou Tar-Shei in search of resources. Beware of the mechanical golems within.
The Carapace Kraken has gone on a mad rampage. Subdue the beast to end the spree and make the area more secure.
Navigate the Endless Waterfalls to find a quicker route to Flou Tar-Shei.
Form an alliance with the khan of Khanoka. This should secure our continued access to the area.
You hear that a khan's armada is vulnerable. An attack could make the area around the Battlements of Ashihama safer for all.
Befriend the Lighthouse Giant situated outside the Battlements of Ashihama, who may well prove to be a useful ally.
Maintain a siege on Ashihama's floating fortress that's located on the southern-most side of the island.
There is a bounty on a Death Lotus assassin operating within the Battlements of Ashihama. Kill her to claim the bounty.
Capture a solitary lighthouse near the Battlements of Ashihama. Beware of the steel golems that run it. It will be a useful asset.
Navigate the whirlpool of fire and ash to find a quicker route to the Hole in the World.
Make contact with an ancient soothsayer from the Hole in the World. Her knowledge of the area is excellent and the monsters that surround the island seem to do her no harm.
Con Rit, the giant centipede, has been spotted near the Hole in the World. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
Befriend Habaek, the shapeshifter, situated south of the Hole in the World who may well prove to be a useful ally.
The Giant Vermilion Bird has been spotted near the Hole in the World. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
Tianlong, the dragon of the skies, has been spotted near the Hole in the World. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
Smuggle ancient bones from New Heritage to your port. Ensure you aren't caught by the authorities.
Free the imprisoned family members of the khan of New Heritage, who are being held captive by the khan of Khanoka.

extra.pop_voyage_name: Umibozu, the Giant of the Sea
extra.pop_voyage_text: Umibozu, the Giant of the Sea, has gone on a mad rampage. Fight the beast to end the spree and make the area more secure.
A plague has spread to the people of Flou Tar-Shei. It's spreading fast. Find a cure, in the Hole in the World, to save them.
Help a wizard who's strayed very far from the Wizards' Tower perform a spell to help him return home.
Rumours have reached your ears regarding an unexplored island known as the Shambling Lair. The opportunity beckons to add a chance of attracting the rare Oxhead and Horseface to your crew.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Battlements of Ashihama.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to New Heritage.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to Khanoka.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Hole in the World.
Raid a small fort on Ren Bo belonging to a group of Purists.
A very important letter concerning a Purist plan to kill a group of sirens has been handed to you. Deliver it to the sirens on Ren Bo as quickly as possible.
Spy on a group of Purists on Ren Bo who are plotting an attack on a local family of seasingers and deliver information to their khan.
A ship full of Purists, ordaining their newest member, has been spotted north of Ren Bo. Sink it!
Make contact with a lone sea orphan from Ren Bo. He can inform you of Purist movements in the area.
Intercede in a fight between Purist thugs and a lone sea orphan, in southern-most Ren Bo.
Provide an escort for a group of sea orphans, who are being persecuted by Purists, on their journey to the south of Ren Bo.
Your help is needed desperately. Protect Haranu from ripper demons summoned by an Occultist.
Your help is needed desperately. Protect Haranu from a tidal wave summoned by an occultist.
Help the khan of Haranu perform a ritual to shield the island from an occultist's curse.
Board a flying turtle, where the occultist is coordinating an attack on Haranu, and claim the life of her minions.
Smuggle illegal cannon shells to Haranu to help in the fight against an occultist. Ensure you aren't caught by the authorities.
The people of Haranu are in desperate need of supplies. Bring aid to help them fight the occultist who's attacking the area.
Free sacrifical victims who are being held captive by a self-proclaimed occultist in her underwater prison, just north of Haranu.
A flat-headed mountain giant has gone on a mad rampage. Bring it down to end the spree and make the area more secure.
Navigate a dangerous and jagged causeway to find a quicker route to The Island that Reflects the Moon.
Free lumber workers who are being held captive by a riddle-loving wide-eyed river giant. Quick thinking is preferable to force.
Your help is needed desperately. Protect a cherrywood lumber camp from attacking wide-eyed river giants.
Smuggle explosives, for killing giants, to The Island that Reflects the Moon. Ensure you aren't caught by the authorities.

extra.pop_voyage_name: The Giant that Blocks the Sun
extra.pop_voyage_text: Mujia the giant has been spotted near a cherrywood grove on The Island that Reflects the Moon. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
Explore The Island that Reflects the Moon in search of resources. Beware of the many giants that live in its mountains.
Explore Aloft Dagger in search of resources. Beware of the soothsayers who own the island.
Navigate sharp, jutting rocks that surround the west coast of Aloft Dagger to find a quicker route to the soothsayer ritual grounds.
Spy on soothsayers on Aloft Dagger and deliver information to a band of seasingers who are planning a raid to rescue their prisoners.
You hear that the soothsayer's demonic army is vulnerable. An attack could make the area around Aloft Dagger safer for all.
Provide an escort for a group of tortured seasingers on their journey to escape the soothsayers of Aloft Dagger.
Intercede in a fight between a group of soothsayers and a band of attacking seasingers.
Wounded seasingers are in desperate need of supplies. Bring aid to Aloft Dagger, to help them in their war against the soothsayers.
Help the people of the Jade Straits with their zombie problem.
Navigate through a thunderous storm that hangs permanently over southern side of the Jade Straits to find a quicker route to a cherrywood grove on the east.
Help a wounded seasinger perform a Chorus of Life, to keep ripper demons - who have been summoned - at bay.
Trade routes are under attack at the Jade Straits. Fight off the attacking shark-riding seasingers to protect the routes.
A plague has spread to the people of the village of Han Lun. Find an old remedy, lost on a wrecked ship in the Jade Straits, to save them.
Intercede in a fight between a pack of terracotta nymphs and an angry cherrywood golem.
There is a bounty on a murderer, wanted in the west. Bring him to Port Sarim to claim the bounty.
A Ship That Hovers On Water - belonging to exiled mercenaries - has been spotted north of the Jade Straits. Sink it!
A towering sea bear has been spotted near Aloft Dagger. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
You hear that a fort belonging to exiled seasingers is vulnerable. An attack could make the area around the Scythe safer for all.
A plague has spread to the people of Haranu. Find a cure by speaking with the sage, in the Enchanted Ivory Forests of Ren Bo, to save them.
Help the soothsayers of Ren Bo perform a powerful Ritual of Light to gain some chi.
Rumours have reached your ears regarding an unexplored island known as the Wind's Home. The opportunity beckons to add a chance of attracting the rare Sea Witch to your crew.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to Ren Bo.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to Haranu.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to The Island that Reflects the Moon.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to Aloft Dagger.
Gongdung, a farming village, has requested help. They've captured a witch who had been killing their oxen, and they need help dealing with her.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Your crew took the supposed 'witch' from the villagers. She killed a single ox for food, and the villagers decided to put her to death with no trial. Strange thing is, the villagers weren't able to kill her...

extra.pop_voyage_text: Investigate the deaths of several westerners in Waiko. Locals claim it to be the work of Incha, the sea harpy.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Sea harpies had nothing to do with the murders. An assassin named Ling was caught running from a gutted merchant in Waiko. She has been brought to you for interrogation.

extra.pop_voyage_text: A sequence of fireworks has been spotted out to sea. Gather a crew to find out who (or what) set them off.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The fireworks were a distress call from a whaler named Hubbub. He was castaway on the shell of a giant turtle.

extra.pop_voyage_text: A biologist from Varrock Museum is interested in the East. Bring her some samples of plant and animal life to see if there is value in sending an expedition.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Your crew has brought a number of samples back from the Arc region, along with rumours of where more can be found.

extra.pop_voyage_text: You've received an anonymous message, requesting passage from the Arc region. The correspondent seeks sanctuary, and can pay in goods or cash.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The mysterious correspondent is a man called Horatio Waxenwing, a convict wanted in the west for a variety of crimes. He seeks to make a new life in the east.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Brother Jered, the head monk of Edgeville Monastery, has arrived at your port. He wants a whistlestop tour of the Eastern Lands.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Brother Jered has noted a lack of faith amongst the people of the Eastern Lands. He has stationed a representative at your port, and given him the task of building a Saradomin church.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Send the Occultist to Seeker Synapse, to cut a piece of the brain at its centre.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Your men distracted the floating eyes, as the Occultist went straight for the brain. She carved out a chunk for the ritual and your ship safely departed.

extra.pop_voyage_name: A Jade Frog in the Throat
extra.pop_voyage_text: Send a ship to Thalassia posing as a trade vessel. Under this cover, your men and the Assassin can depose Khan Tombi, and install a new leader.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Tombi has been killed, having choked on a handful of jade. Your crew have installed a new khan in his place. Tombi's slavery operations in Waiko have foundered.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Send the Whaler to the Bay of Echoes so he can save the Bay of Echoes and confront Shuma, the deaf whale.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Pirates were scuttling ships off the Bay of Echoes. You destroyed one of their galleons before they retreated. The bay is thankful and safe.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Biologist wants a tour of the sea orphan island of Hyu-Ji, found somewhere in the Hook region. She plans to find a good spot to start recording her findings.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Bethan has filled several notebooks of observations in a remarkably short period of time. She seems quite excited.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Convict seeks passage to the sea orphan island of Hyu-Ji. When he gets there, he hopes to make a new life for himself.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Convict is observing the natives and learning their ways, in preparation for the next stage of his new life. He has sent you a letter.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Missionary wants to find a suitable and distant place for his mission. Search the Skull for likely spots.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Missionary has found a place where he believes the word of Saradomin can thrive, given enough impetus: an island of misfits known as Hyu-Ji.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Send the Occultist to the Keening Reef, where she will cut out a chunk of the body for her ritual.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Your ship was attacked by younger sea monsters, led by one a warrior on an albino narwhal. While your crew defended the ship, The Occultist managed to gather a chunk of The Body.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Send a ship to the the Rapa Causeway. The Assassin is planning to catch up with Bak, so that she can 'persuade' him to keep her name from the Death Lotus.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Firebird Inn is on fire, and the Assassin escaped onto your boat with Bak. Your crew has informed you that Bak was sedated and partially aflame.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Shuma is attacking the crabbing town of Honazo. Evacuate the townsfolk before she does too much damage.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: You evacuated everyone safely, but the town has been levelled. Shuma looked the Whaler in the eye, but the Whaler chose to evacuate the townsfolk.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Blazing Lanterns have kidnapped a sea orphan and tied him to the front of their ship. Recover him so that the Biologist can find out how he is resistant to his own poison.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Your crew caused mayhem on the high seas, and came away with Finia, the sea orphans' sorcerer. The Biologist had over-reacted – he had merely been captive, rather than strapped to the ship.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Convict has orchestrated it so that you must fight his pursuers. Fight them so that the sea orphans are left unthreatened.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: You have sunk the pursuers' ship! He was a White Knight from Falador, and he employed several other off-duty White Knights to help kill the Convict.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Rout the Zamorakian missionaries in the Hook, before they kill or convert the sea orphans of Hyu-Ji.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: A Zamorakian missionary ship, Pride in Chaos, is wreckage on the sea floor. The Missionary remains unsatisfied.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Take the Occultist to Aloft Dagger, the tower of the soothsayers. In the grounds of the tower, she will gather the blood from moss that grows on sacrificed bodies.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Occultist managed to gather the blood from Aloft Dagger. Upon returning to the ship, however, a khan named Oroshu was waiting with a hundred guards, and he took the blood, body and brain.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Wu is stationed on The Island that Reflects the Moon. Help the Assassin to take his head.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Wu was half-way through a battered squid ring when the Assassin removed his head.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Shuma is headed through the Jade Straits, on a mission to attack the human city of New Heritage. Get in her way and stop her from getting past.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Shuma took a battering from your cannons and spears, and you slowed her down considerably. She continued onwards.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Bethan may be able to unlock the secrets of the sea orphans' resistance to illness, but she needs some infected material from a plague ship.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Bethan has collected a bell jar full of plague cloths. She has begun infecting Finian, and is studying him intensely.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Convict is concerned about disappearances among the sea orphans. Lend him men to help investigate the phenomenon.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Convict's investigations are conclusive: the sea orphans are being captured by mercenaries with the intention of selling their 'parts' to soothsayers.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Fanatics are set to descend on Hyu-Ji with two ships. The Missionary will lead the offensive.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Your ship obliterated one ship - the Bloodied Tusk. Sadly, the Missionary did not act quickly enough to stop the other ship, and crazed Purists took several orphan lives.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Travel to Falling Blossom, the home of Oroshu. While the wedding distracts the guests, steal the Body, Brain and Blood. As the guests fight over the Occultist, make an escape.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: You have successfully escaped with the Occultist and the Body, Brain and Blood! Discord – Quin's personal seasinger – killed Oshoru and the majority of the soothsayers, who also arrived for the wedding.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Baby Tooth, leader of the Death Lotus, is visiting the training camps of Tokoko. Help the Assassin kill Baby Tooth.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The plot was a trap. The Assassin entered Baby Tooth's room and triggered an explosion that threw her clear of the building. Death Lotus assassins attacked, but your men held them off and carried the unconscious Assassin to the ship.

extra.pop_voyage_name: The Old Man of the Sea
extra.pop_voyage_text: The Whaler has a plan: to enlist the help of the Old Man of the Sea, a hermit who can communicate with sea monsters.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Whaler accidentally woke the sea monsters, but the Old Man of the Sea stopped them from attacking. The Old Man of the Sea refused to leave his home, but gave Hubbub a gift that will help with Shuma.

extra.pop_voyage_text: A mutated plague is rampant among the sea orphans. The Biologist seeks a rare medicinal herb to aid them.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The cure worked! The sea orphan plague is fading fast, thanks to the swift work of your crew and the Biologist.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Get the Convict to the claymistress, so that she can change the Convict into one of the Lost Men. Once the Convict is disguised, he'll lead the council to the storehouse of sea orphans.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Thanks to the Convict's infiltration, the khan's deal with the soothsayers has been revealed. Tubjub is disgraced and exiled, and no sea orphan has lost their intestines.

extra.pop_voyage_text: There's a mythical place in the Bowl that 'opens the heart to truth'. Find it, for the Missionary's sake.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Saradomin works in mysterious ways: the Missionary has had a successful trip.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Get to The Hole in the World before Discord grabs the Occultist, or the Occultist throws herself down a bottomless pit.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Discord was killed; tossed into the Hole in the World. The Occultist has agreed to sail with your crew to say a final goodbye. She's not happy about it, though.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Send a ship to attack Pearl Fortress: the Death Lotus headquarters. The Assassin will try to kill Baby Tooth, their leader.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Your forces broke through Pearl Fortress and held off the Death Lotus assassins. The Assassin hunted down Baby Tooth and took his head! Congratulations!

extra.pop_voyage_text: Evacuate New Heritage while The Whaler waits on a raft, ready to be eaten by Shuma. He'll use the few moments before digestion to convince Shuma that Quin is the real enemy.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Shuma turned at the last moment and vomited the Whaler on to land. New Heritage is safe, and a smelly Whaler returns, victorious! Congratulations!

extra.pop_voyage_text: A pirate raid is about to arrive at Hyu-Ji island, and the sea orphans are too weak from the plague to fight effectively. It's time to send in the heavies.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Between your men, Bethan's chemicals and the best efforts of the stricken Hyu-Ji, the pirates have fled back to the Bowl.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The exiled khan, Tubjub, has amassed an army of The Lost Men to invade Hyu-Ji. The island is doomed unless the Convict can meet them with explosives.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The khan's assault ends in hail and fire, as luggage filled with gunpowder and shell fragments are dropped in the path of the mercenary ships. Hyu-Ji is safe.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Travel to the mercenary fleet, and pay them to level the Zamorakian base, hopefully taking the Purists with them.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The mercenaries fell upon the Zamorakian base like the proverbial thunderbolt. The Purists and Zamorakians have been almost completely routed.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Send The Whaler to The Glittercaves, where Shuma lives. He will convince Shuma to take part in your plan.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: On the way, you were attacked by sea monsters. They were more agitated and aggressive than usual. The Whaler used his psychic link to talk to Shuma, and she has been convinced to help.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Send the Assassin to Tattanogi, the home town of Kirau. There, she will attempt to convince Kirau's pirate crew to join you in killing Quin.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Assassin was welcomed by Kirau's family and crewmates. There was no resentment or attack, and Kirau's crew happily agreed to aid you.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Head out to begin the assault on paradise!
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Quin is dead! The Occultist found Quin on the top of her Palace, and cut her open. Everything went to plan, and both the sea monsters and the assassins are scattered to the winds.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Convict has heard of an offensive by rogue soothsayers; the Biologist has heard of an assault by pirates; the Missionary has heard of Purists planning to wipe out the orphans. But which is true?
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Convict swapped notes with the other khans, and the truth is worrying: all three rumours are accurate. A storm of woe is coming to Hyu-Ji.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Convict and the Missionary are organising the defence. While they prepare the orphans, send the Biologist to Hanto to collect combustible materials.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Hyu-Ji is as safe as it will ever be. The island is defensible, the orphans trained, and the Biologist has returned with your crew, pulling a trolley full of chemicals.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The attack has begun, and the fate of Hyu-Ji is about to be decided in cannonfire and steel. Rendez-vous with Jered and bring his White Knights to the battle.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The sea orphans are battered and bloodied, but Hyu-Ji has survived! Between you, the orphans, the Convict, the Missionary, the Biologist and some White Knights, the island is safe – for one more day.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Biologist believes she knows the location of a supply of bamboo. Help her evade tusked lions and claim it.
The Whaler knows of a chest full of bamboo that's sunk to the bottom of the ocean. Help him retrieve it.
The Assassin has heard that a slaver on Waiko has a vast supply of bamboo, help her 'take' it from him.
The Convict knows of a safe in Goshima that is full of bamboo. Help him break into it.
The Occultist understands that there's bamboo near an old magical site. Help her obtain it.
Praise Saradomin! The Missionary knows of a supply of bamboo near a small camp of Zamorakian monks. Help him claim it.
The Whaler and the Biologist have tracked down a big surplus of bamboo in the waters surrounding Tuai Leit. Their knowledge of sea creatures is essential to retrieve these resources.
The Assassin and Convict report that an unsavoury slaver is transporting a huge shipment of bamboo. Help the duo secure the resource.
The Missionary and Occultist have felt a magical disturbance near Waiko. This magical energy can be used to uncover a source of bamboo.
The Barmaid has heard some interesting gossip concerning Waiko and a shipment of bamboo.
The Partner tells you resources are needed to get the port back in action.
There are riches to be had in these seas, but the port's in no shape for adventure yet.
The adventurer in your port has provided you with the opportunity to seek more bamboo and chimes by exploring the Island of Waiko.
Raid a slave ship belonging to a mining gang, who operate on the Rapa Causeway.
The navigator has found rich resources in a submerged cavern under the Rapa Causeway. Send a ship to locate and retrieve them.
Befriend a clansman from the Blazing Lantern clan situated on the Rapa Causeway who may well prove to be a useful ally.
Explore a rickety old merchant ship, belonging to a merchant sea orphan, in search of resources. Beware of razor-sharp coral and the reef sharks that swim close to the shores.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with a rickety old merchant ship, belonging to a merchant sea orphan, for stolen black slate.
Intercede in a fight between pirates from the Gold Katanas clan and the Blazing Lanterns clan.
Few have ever sailed to the Onyx Obelisk north of the Rapa Causeway and lived to tell the tale. Perhaps your ship can last the distance.
Intercede in a fight between a mining gang and their escaped slaves.
Explore the Teardrop Islands in search of resources. Beware of the mines capable of wrecking a ship that litter the coasts.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with the Ken Ji Mining Guild for black slate.
Board an unused mining vessel and claim the black slate that has been left on it.
Make contact with a representative of the Ken Ji Mining Guild from the Teardrop Islands.
Intercede in a fight between pirates from the Storm Riders clan and the Gold Katanas clan.
Sabotage mining operations on the Teardrop Islands to ensure we remain competitive.
An old armour-plated warship has been spotted north of Rei Ti. Sink it!
Navigate jagged rocks and strong tides to find a quicker route to Rei Ti.
Free a group of miners who are being held captive by a black slate golem that emerged from their mine.
Your help is needed desperately. Protect a colony of Keldagrim dwarves from the local miners who resent their presence.
Help a group of Keldagrim dwarves establish a small colony on Rei Ti - they've heard of the veins of Black Slate that run through it.
A land shark has been spotted near a mining colony on Rei Ti. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
Explore the Bay of Playful Sirens in search of resources. Beware of the slavers who target lone ships.
Raid a small mining compound belonging to slavers.
Navigate terrible currents to find a quicker route to the Bay of Playful Sirens.
Befriend an exiled soothsayer, situated on the Bay of Playful Sirens, who may well prove to be a useful ally.
You hear that a small floating fortress, being used as a hideout by slavers, is vulnerable. An attack could make the area around Bay of Playful Sirens safer for all.
A very important letter concerning a plan to manipulate the price of Black Slate has been handed to you. Deliver it to head of the Ken Ji Mining Guild as quickly as possible.
Intercede in a fight between pirates from the Blazing Lantern clan and the Storm Riders clan.
A passing trader has found rich resources down a wishing well in an old town on Fistmarks of Genma. Send a ship to locate and retrieve them.
There is a bounty on a seasinger who's been driving the local sea creatures into a frenzy. Kill her to claim the bounty.
Few have ever sailed to the Gulf of Fury, north of the Fistmarks of Genma and lived to tell the tale. Perhaps your captain can last the distance.
Help a lone soothsayer perform a Ritual of Fair Tides on the Earthquake Straits.
Board a Ship That Hovers on Water, near the Earthquake Straits, and claim the black slate on board.
Help a group of soothsayers perform a Ritual of Calm Skies to protect the local miners.
Intercede in a fight between a lone soothsayer and the demonic creature she has accidently summoned.
Free a family of sirens who are being held captive by a two-headed razor snake.
Intercede in a fight between a convoy of turtle-riding traders, who are transporting ancient bones, and the exiles who are pursuing them.
Board the Flying Ship of Ozmo and claim the stocks of plate.
A giant one-eyed, barbed-beaked flycatcher has been spotted near the Bay of Playful Sirens. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
There is a bounty on a rogue soothsayer, rumoured to be summoning demonic creatures. Bring him before the khan of Rei Ti to claim the bounty.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with a shadowy trader, somewhere on the Teardrop Islands, for spices.
Rumours have reached your ears regarding an unexplored island known as the Forgotten Chimera Straits. The opportunity beckons to add a chance of attracting the rare Chimera to your crew.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability (the Plucky trait) by journeying to the Fistmarks of Genma. (Your captain can have four traits maximum)
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability (the Quick-Footed trait) by journeying to the Teardrop Islands. (Your captain can have four traits maximum)
The Biologist believes that there's important knowledge to be had at Flou Tar-Shei by studying the shape-shifting flowers that are native to the area. Help the Biologist uncover their secrets.
The Whaler believes that there's much to be learned from island-sized whales by swimming with them and learning their ways. Help the Whaler hone this techniques.
The Assassin thinks there's a chance to practice her craft at Khanoka by thinning the numbers of the khan's corrupt advisors who work there. Help the Assassin practice her craft.
The Convict thinks there are opportunities for perfecting his trade on Yamada Island. There are a lot of banks on which to hone his abilities.

The Occultist wishes to obtain the secrets of the lighthouse golems located on Yamada Island. They seem to be powered by an old magical energy. Uncovering these secrets will impart powerful knowledge.
The Missionary believes that there's ample opportunity for practicing his calling at Khanoka. There are plotters and schemers, and other men of vice who need to hear the word of Saradomin.
The Biologist and the Whaler have uncovered a new species of octopus. The creature's skin is made of gold and gems. The two of them wish to join forces to hunt and study them.

The Assassin and Convict wish to hone their techniques at Khanoka: the home of backhand deals and duplicity. There's plenty of opportunity to practice thievery and contract killing, and to learn from eachother.
The Missionary and Occultist wish to visit the home of the Giant Bearded Turtle to study and unlock the mystical secrets surrounding its very, very, very long life.
The Biologist believes she knows the location of a supply of ancient bones. Help her evade the great rocs that are native to Flou Tar-Shei and claim it.
The Whaler knows of a chest full of plate that's sunk to the bottom of the ocean. Help him retrieve it.
The Assassin has heard that the khan of New Heritage's chef has a vast supply of spices. Help her 'take' it from him.
The Convict knows of a safe in Khanoka's palace that is full of lacquer, amongst other goods. Help him break into it.
The Occultist understands that there's magical energy near the volcano that spews sulphur and death. Help her obtain it.
Praise Saradomin! The Missionary knows of a source of ancient bones near the Forest Where Men are Lost Forever. Help him claim them.
The Whaler and the Biologist have tracked down a big surplus of plate in the Shallow Ocean where Kraken Wallow. Their knowledge of sea creatures is essential to retrieving these resources.
The Assassin and Convict report that the khan of Yamada Island is transporting a huge shipment of lacquer on his ship 'The Million Eyes'. Help the duo secure the resource.
The Missionary and Occultist have felt a magical disturbance near the Forest of Ever-Burning Trees. This magical energy can be used to uncover a source of chi.
The Barmaid has heard some interesting gossip concerning New Heritage and a shipment of stainless steel.

The Biologist thinks she's uncovered a rare piece of a forgotten scroll in the forest near the Battlements of Ashihama. There's the threat of the cherrywood titan that circles the forest. Her knowledge will prove invalulable on this voyage.
The Whaler has tracked down a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. However it's being protected by a twelve-headed hydra. His prowess at battling many-headed hydras will be essential for success.

The Assassin has located a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. However, it's being held by the Judge of Dice on Khanoka. Assassinate the Judge of Dice and obtain it. The Assassin's deadly skills will be pivotal.

The Convict has been informed that a rare piece of a forgotten scroll is in the hands of a Blazing Lantern chieftain. Help him raid the Blazing Lantern's barracks to claim it. His skills will prove vital for success.

The Occultist has tracked down a rare piece of a forgotten scroll, but it is protected by magic. Head to the Hole in the World, decode the ancient spell that protects it and take the scroll. Her magical prowess will be an essential asset on this voyage.

The Missionary has heard that a rare piece of a forgotten scroll has fallen into the hands of a Zamorakian priest preaching in Khanoka. Help him whip up a frenzy, disrupt the sermon, and take the scroll. His fast tongue and swift hand will prove crucial.
The Biologist believes she knows the location of a supply of stainless steel. Help her evade low-flying dragons of ash and claim it.
The Whaler knows of a chest full of stainless steel that's sunk to the bottom of the Ocean. Help him retrieve it.
The Assassin has heard that the khan of New Heritage's seasinger has a vast supply of stainless steel, help her 'take' it from him.
The Convict knows of a safe in Khanoka, deep underground that is full of stainless steel. Help him break into it.
The Occultist understands that there are resources near the Grove of Trees that Eat Oxen. Help her obtain them.
Praise Saradomin! The Missionary knows of a source of stainless steel near a newly established temple of Zamorak. Help him claim them.
The Whaler and the Biologist have tracked down a big surplus of stainless steel in the Sea of Ice that Does Not Melt. Their knowledge of sea creatures is essential to retrieving these resources.
The Assassin and Convict report that the khan of New Heritage is transporting a huge shipment of stainless steel. Help the duo secure the resource.
The Missionary and Occultist have felt a magical disturbance near Yamada Island. This magical energy can be used to uncover a source of stainless steel.
Raid an armed rowing boat belonging to slavers who are travelling from Menaphos.
Explore the waters near Tuai Leit in search of resources. Beware of sharks.
Help a small group of gnomes establish a colony in the forests of Tuai Leit.
Intercede in a fight between a group of gnomes, travelling to the east, and a small band of pirates.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with a group of gnomes, who've just arrived on Tuai Leit, for a small quantity of bamboo.
Intercede in a fight between Port Sarim merchants and a merchant from Ardougne, on the coasts of Tuai Leit.
Few have ever sailed to the rocky outcrops near Tuai Leit and lived to tell the tale. Perhaps your crew can last the distance.
Raid a whaling storehouse in Whale's Maw belonging to a group of callous whalers.
Explore the waters around Whale's Maw in search of resources. Beware of the whales that give the place its name.
Befriend a local fisherman in Whale's Maw who may well prove to be a useful ally.
A group of Saradominist priests are travelling to a place of religious significance on the coasts of Whale's Maw. Help keep them safe on their pilgrimage.
Native fishermen are in desperate need of supplies. Bring aid to Whale's Maw.
Intercede in a fight between pirates from Mos Le'Harmless and eastern traders from Waiko.
Explore the Arc Island group in search of resources. Beware of opportunist pirates.
Free a group of enslaved fishermen who are being held captive by a rather bloodthirsty merchant.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with a rich merchant from Waiko for a quantity of Bamboo.
Befriend the khan of Waiko's personal chef who may well prove to be a useful ally.
A group of Guthix worshippers are travelling to a site of magical significance on the merchant island of Waiko. Help keep them safe on their pilgrimage.
Help a group of druids from Taverley establish a small colony on Goshima, the local residents of Gongdung are suspicious of them.
Free a group of imprisoned merchants and traders who are being held captive by a rogue band of thugs called the Skulls.
Your captain has found rich resources on the submerged bay near Goshima. Send a ship to locate and retrieve them.
Raid a small camp belonging to Goshima smugglers.
Navigate through strong currents to find a quicker route to Goshima.
Befriend an influential trader who operates from the Islands That Once Were Turtles. He may well prove to be a useful ally.
Raid a small assault ship belonging to a group of thugs called the Skulls.
Make contact with a well connected trader on a ship docked north of the Islands That Once Were Turtles.
Explore the forest covering the Islands that Once were Turtles in search of resources. Beware of the old spirits that are said to haunt it.
A useful contact has found rich resources on the Islands That Once Were Turtles. Send a ship to locate and retrieve them.
Raid a small fort on one of the Islands that Once were Turtles, belonging to a group of thugs called the Skulls.
Navigate dangerous waters to find a quicker route to The Isles of Aminishi. This route may be useful in the future.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with the new eastern markets for high-grade bamboo.
A group of Zamorakian monks are travelling to a place of magic on the Isles of Aminishi. Help keep them safe on their pilgrimage.
Natives of the Isles of Aminishi are in desperate need of supplies. Bring aid to them as quickly as possible. Before it's too late.
Intercede in a fight between vicious Port Sarim pirates and ruthless Eastern Exiles.
Explore the waters around the Isles of Aminishi in search of resources. Beware of flocks of flying squid that migrate west at this time of year.
Rumours have reached your ears regarding an unexplored island known as Cyclosis. The opportunity beckons to add a chance of attracting the rare Cyclops to your crew.
The Biologist believes that there's important knowledge to be had from the sleeping squid of Tattanogi by studying their excrement. Help the Biologist uncover their secrets.
The Whaler believes that there's much to be learned from the invisible salmon of Kei Pi by trying to catch them. Help the Whaler hone his techniques.
The Assassin thinks there's a chance to practice her craft at the inns of Falling Blossom by thinning the numbers of merceneries and thugs there. Help the Assassin practice her craft.
The Convict thinks there's opportunities for perfecting his trade at the towns of Tattanogi. There's a lot of merchants with loose purses on which to hone his abilities.
The Occultist wishes to obtain the secrets of the Bashe located in the valleys of the Isle of Juniper. Uncovering these secrets will impart powerful knowledge.
The Missionary believes that there's ample opportunity for answering his calling at Tokoko. There are Death Lotus assassins, caught in a life of sin, who need to hear the word of Saradomin.
The Biologist and the Whaler have uncovered a new species of whale. The two of them wish to join forces and track the creatures movements.
The Assassin and Convict wish to hone their techniques at the pirate ports of Kei Pi. There's plenty of opportunity to practice their skills and learn from each other.
The Missionary and Occultist wish to visit the Gardens of the One-Footed Celestial Stag to study and unlock the mystical secrets surrounding the ancient magic that lingers there.
The Biologist believes she knows the location of a supply of ancient bones in the caverns beneath Falling Blossom. Help her evade tree-root giants and claim it.
The Whaler knows of a chest full of plate, near the Isle of Juniper, that's sunk to the bottom of the Ocean. Help him retrieve it.
The Assassin has heard that a merman who lures captains to their deaths has a vast supply of spices. Help her 'take' it from him.
The Convict knows of a safe in the palace of Falling Blossom that is full of lacquer. Help him break into it.
The Occultist understands that there's magical energy near a sacrifical site, on the Isle of Juniper, that is haunted by the spirits of the dead. Help her obtain it.
Praise Saradomin! The Missionary knows of a source of ancient bones near a forgotten relic of Saradomin. Help him claim them.
The Whaler and the Biologist have tracked down a big surplus of plate in the belly of Ao, the giant turtle. Their knowledge of sea creatures is essential to retrieve these resources.
The Assassin and Convict report that a rogue Storm Rider clansman is transporting a huge shipment of lacquer. Help the duo secure the resource.
The Missionary and Occultist have felt a magical disturbance near the deep gulf of Tattanogi. This magical energy can be used to uncover a source of chi.
The Barmaid has heard some interesting gossip concerning Kei Pi and a shipment of jade.

The Biologist thinks she's uncovered a rare piece of a forgotten scroll within the submerged ships of Tattanogi. There's the threat of poisonous snapping star fish. Her knowledge will prove invalulable on this voyage.
The Whaler has tracked down a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. However it's being protected by Teng the soaring sea snake. His prowess at battling sea monsters will be essential for success.

The Assassin has located a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. However it's being held by a bounty hunter, hiding on the Isle of Juniper. Assassinate the bounty hunter and obtain it. The Assassin's deadly skills will be pivotal.

The Convict has been informed that a rare piece of a forgotten scroll is in a picture frame hanging over the bed of a rich merchant. Help him raid the merchant's complex to claim it. His skills will prove vital for success.

The Occultist has tracked down a rare piece of a forgotten scroll, but it is protected by magic. Head to the Glittercaves, perform a Ritual of Clear Eyes to reveal its location and take the scroll. Her magical prowess will be an essential asset on this voyage.

The Missionary has heard that a rare piece of a forgotten scroll has fallen into the hands of rogue sea orphans. Help him convince them that they do not need it and take the scroll. His fast tongue and swift hand will prove crucial.

Raid a storehouse belonging to a group of aggressive exiles.
A contact has found rich resources on a shipwreck near the Sunlit Veil. Send a ship to locate and retrieve them.
Befriend mermaid situated on a rock nearby the Sunlit Veil who may well prove to be a useful ally.
Explore the salt caves beneath the Sunlit Veil in search of resources. Beware of the merfolk who live within the caves.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with the khan of Sunlit Veil for a small supply of gunpowder.
Intercede in a fight between mermaids and a small band of exiles.
Few have ever sailed to the Empty Lagoon near Hanto and lived to tell the tale. Perhaps your ship can last the distance.
Raid a gunpowder factory belonging to the tyrannical khan of Hanto.

The khan of Ai Jei has found rich resources on a neighbouring island. We need to get there first. Send a ship to locate and retrieve them.

extra.task_details: Send ships to explore the fabled Eastern Lands and bring back loot and lost knowledge.
extra.task_step_1: The portal leading to your port is found just north of <col=ffffff>Port Sarim</col>.
extra.task_step_2: Anyone can visit the port, but to send ships you must have reached <col=ffffff>level 90</col> in at least one of these skills:
extra.task_step_3: <col=ffffff>Fishing</col>, <col=ffffff>Runecrafting</col>, <col=ffffff>Herblore</col>, <col=ffffff>Slayer</col>, <col=ffffff>Thieving</col>, <col=ffffff>Prayer</col>, <col=ffffff>Hunter</col>, <col=ffffff>Cooking</col> or <col=ffffff>Construction</col>.
extra.task_step_4: Making many of the rewards requires high levels in <col=ffffff>Smithing</col>, <col=ffffff>Crafting</col>, <col=ffffff>Runecrafting</col>, <col=ffffff>Cooking</col> and <col=ffffff>Fletching</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Experience, and the means to make <col=ffffff>powerful armour</col> and support items.

extra.task_details: Using your Construction skill, build a statue to honour a god, working alongside the master sculptor Copernicus Glyph.
extra.task_step_1: Talk to <col=ffffff>Copernicus Glyph</col> in <col=ffffff>Taverley</col>, <col=ffffff>Falador</col>, <col=ffffff>Canifis</col>, <col=ffffff>Gu'Tanoth</col> or <col=ffffff>Prifddinas</col> to start working on a statue.

extra.skillguide_info: You can now hunt oculi apoterrasaurs in Anachronia. Its preferred bait is: Raw asciatops meat.

extra.task_details: Cheer in the cabbage field north of Port Sarim when there are no cabbages in it.
extra.task_step_1: You might need some friends to help you pick all the cabbages. Don't forget to use the cheer emote when the field is cleared!

extra.task_details: Duel with another player in the Duel Arena near Al-Kharid.
extra.task_step_1: Find a friend and test your skill. You must finish the duel to pass this challenge but it does not have to be staked.

extra.task_details: Train at least 15 different skills in a day.
extra.task_step_1: Any XP gain will count, even a small one! If you have already maxed your skills, anything that would get you XP normally will also work.

extra.task_details: Fill your inventory with 28 different types of food and drink, then eat something.
extra.task_step_1: Any type of food or drink will count, provided that they heal you. Once you've got a full inventory eat or drink any one of the items to pass the challenge.

extra.task_details: Talk to 10 different signature heroes, kings, queens or rulers.
extra.task_step_1: You don't have to have a meaningful conversation, just attempt to talk to them.

extra.task_details: Find an active crystal tree.
extra.task_step_1: If you find a crystal tree, inspect it. If it is active you will pass the challenge, otherwise it will give you a hint as to where the active tree can be found.

extra.task_details: Complete a game of Soul Wars.
extra.task_step_1: The portal to Soul Wars can be found near Edgeville.

extra.task_details: Harvest from the same wisp as at least 4 other people.
extra.task_step_1: You have to be quick, since the wisp could vanish at any time.

extra.task_details: Gather 200 divine tears on the battlefield.
extra.task_step_1: Only tears gathered on the battlefield by Lumbridge through combat or by skilling will count.

extra.task_details: Find 10 items in a drop party in Falador's Party Room.
extra.task_step_1: You don't have to pick up the item, just find it in a balloon. You may have to donate some items to help start the party!

extra.task_details: Successfully complete a game of Sinkholes.
extra.task_step_1: You can find out more about the next Sinkhole by talking to Talsar in Daemonheim.

extra.task_details: Finish a game of Big Chinchompa.
extra.task_step_1: You can find out more by talking to Mieliki Tapio in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

extra.task_details: Finish a floor in Daemonheim in less than 5 minutes.
extra.task_step_1: Head up to Daemonheim and see how quickly you can finish a floor. You must finish the floor in less than 5 minutes to complete the challenge.

extra.task_details: Catch, or assist someone in catching, a big fish during a game of Fish Flingers.
extra.task_step_1: Fish Flingers can be started by speaking to the Fisherman who can be found at most fishing spots around Gielinor. You will need the help of other players to get the big fish.

extra.task_details: Find the golden gnome!
extra.task_step_1: You can find the gnome by looking around by yourself or by asking other players.  Don't hang around, however, as the gnome will move every hour.

extra.task_details: Enter a player-Owned house with at least 5 other people in it.
extra.task_step_1: The house can be your own house - just invite all your friends around for a party.

extra.task_details: Complete the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course in a costume.
extra.task_step_1: Any of the following costumes will count: mime, zombie, frog prince or princess, jester, HAM cultist, bird, clown, Ozan, Ariane, Linza, Sir Owen, Super September

extra.task_details: Perform any emote on top of Varrock, Lumbridge, Falador and Ardougne castles.
extra.task_step_1: It doesn't matter which emote you use - be creative!

extra.task_details: Gain a social slayer point.
extra.task_step_1: You will need to find a partner using your enchanted gem. Once you've done this, talk to a slayer master and get a social slayer assignment.

extra.task_details: Run from the Wilderness wall to the deep Wilderness wall without dying or teleporting.
extra.task_step_1: You have to cross both walls to pass this challenge. Remember that in the Wilderness you could come under attack from other players, so don't take things you can't afford to lose. You cannot teleport or die, doing so will fail the challenge.

extra.task_details: Trigger 10 portents of restoration.
extra.task_step_1: You can make portents using the Divination skill. Portents trigger automatically when you go below half health.

extra.task_details: Pray at altars devoted to three different gods.
extra.task_step_1: Altars are found throughout Gielinor, and some are devoted to a specific god. You need to find altars devoted to three different gods to pass this challenge.

extra.task_details: Have all six of your Grand Exchange slots filled with either buy or sell offers.
extra.task_step_1: The offers can be completed. If you have already done this, you can complete this challenge by visiting the Grand Exchange and talking to a clerk.

extra.task_details: Help a yellow wizard in the Runespan.
extra.task_step_1: You can find a portal to the Runespan on top of the Wizards' Tower. Speak to Wizard Finix to find out more about yellow wizards.

extra.task_details: Kill 3 criminals.
extra.task_step_1: Take to the streets and bring justice to the criminals! Thieves, highwaymen, rogues and muggers are all possible targets.

extra.task_details: Start and completely fill two different urns.
extra.task_step_1: You have to start and finish the urn for it to count towards the challenge, and the two urns must be of a different type.

extra.task_details: Gain a health boost from a bonfire tended to by at least 4 other players.
extra.task_step_1: Find a bonfire and add logs to it - it takes 5 logs to get a health bonus. Don't forget to invite your friends to add logs too.

extra.task_details: Throw a rotten tomato at a player in a pillory.
extra.task_step_1: You can find pillories in Varrock, Yanille and the Seer's Village.

extra.mtxmgt_source_custom: This title is unlocked by using the maul of omens to defeat Vorago in hard mode.

extra.rewardshop_tooltip: This item requires a Ranged level of 80 to wield and will last 10 hours in combat before it requires recharging.
extra.rewardshop_requirements: You need level 70 in Dungeoneering and level 80 in Ranged to buy this.

extra.cheevo_details: Find every ancient aviansie spirit at Stormguard.
Attempt to be funny and show a primal feast to someone who won't appreciate it at Stormguard.

extra.cheevo_rewards: 'Bandosian Expert' title.

extra.cheevo_details: Fully explore the history of the Warforge Dig Site.
Complete all the Warforge mysteries.
extra.cheevo_rewards: Access to the site manager as a consultant for your research team.

extra.cheevo_details: Complete all of the listed research.
Solve this mystery.

extra.poh_bookcase_info: An excerpt taken from the memoirs of Thaerisk Cemphier of the Crux Eqal.

extra.task_details: Help Foreman George rebuild Lumbridge.
extra.task_step_1: Speak to Foreman George near Explorer Jack's house, North of Lumbridge Castle.

extra.task_details: Enter a competition to try and land the biggest catch.
extra.task_step_1: Speak to a <col=ffffff>fisherman</col> to get started. They can be found in most towns.
extra.task_step_2: You need an entry ticket to take part and you can get new tickets <col=ffffff>each day</col> from a fisherman.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>Fishing</col> experience and <col=ffffff>fish tokens</col> which can be exchanged for various angling-oriented rewards.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Fish flingers is a regular fishing competition in which those with a love of angling can prove their skill in a race to land the most and the heaviest catches.

extra.task_details: Fight through random dungeons with a party of adventurers to seek out hidden treasure.
extra.task_step_1: For more information, and to be teleported to the currently active sinkhole, speak to <col=ffffff>Talsar</col> in <col=ffffff>Daemonheim</col>.
extra.task_step_2: You must form a party of <col=ffffff>2 to 5</col> adventurers to enter these dungeons and raid their wealth.
extra.task_step_3: You can enter a sinkhole <col=ffffff>twice per day</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives <col=ffffff>XP</col>, <col=ffffff>Dungeoneering tokens</col> and cosmetic armour.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Sinkholes filled with treasure are appearing all over Gielinor. Battle through them with a party of adventurers, then compete against these adventurers in a card game to claim the best treasure.

extra.task_details: Follow clues to find buried treasure.
extra.task_step_1: When certain creatures die, there is a chance that they will drop a <col=ffffff>sealed clue scroll</col>.
extra.task_step_2: You can own up to 25 clue scrolls of each tier at any one time.
extra.task_rewards: Varies depending on the tier of clue scroll, but includes <col=ffffff>armour</col>, <col=ffffff>equipment</col> and <col=ffffff>potions</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Sealed clue scrolls are dropped by various creatures in the world. These clues will lead you to hidden treasure if you can work out their meaning.

extra.task_details: Help defend Burthorpe from the Troll Invasion by fighting or repairing the gatehouse.
extra.task_step_1: To play, travel to <col=ffffff>Burthorpe</col> and speak with <col=ffffff>Captain Jute</col> outside the castle's west wall.
extra.task_step_5: You can practice this activity as often as you like, but can only claim the reward <col=ffffff>once per month</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Gives combat or non-combat skill <col=ffffff>experience</col> depending on the type of defence performed.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Help defend Burthorpe from the Troll Invasion! In this timed game, you can fend off the trolls in direct combat - fighting waves of trolls - or man the gatehouse, keeping it in top condition using non-combat skills.

extra.task_details: Raid heavily guarded camps in the Wilderness to thin their forces and plunder supplies.
extra.task_step_1: Camps of dedicated followers to the four main gods occasionally appear in the <col=ffffff>Wilderness</col>.
extra.task_step_2: You can speak to <col=ffffff>Quercus</col> in <col=ffffff>Edgeville</col> for more information on where the current camp is.
extra.task_step_3: You can take part in <col=ffffff>3</col> raids per day.
extra.task_rewards: <col=ffffff>Coins</col>, XP in <col=ffffff>Construction</col>, <col=ffffff>Farming</col>, <col=ffffff>Herblore</col>, <col=ffffff>Mining</col> and <col=ffffff>Smithing</col> and the chance to find a <col=ffffff>level 70 wand of treachery</col>.
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Heavily guarded camps are appearing in the Wilderness. Find these camps with Quercus's help and raid their supplies. Sneak through, avoiding the guards and other players to destroy their central command beam.

extra.task_details: Fight fellow adventurers in battles to the death in huge underground caverns.
extra.task_step_1: The entrance to <col=ffffff>Deathmatch</col> is within <col=ffffff>Edgeville</col>.
extra.task_step_2: This is a <col=ffffff>safe area</col>. If you die in this location, you will <col=ffffff>not</col> lose your items.
extra.task_step_3: You may play deathmatch <col=ffffff>as often as you wish</col>.
extra.task_rewards: Deathmatch reward points which can be traded for <col=ffffff>taunts</col>, <col=ffffff>titles</col> and <col=ffffff>untradeable PvP supplies</col>
extra.dndtracker_full_description: Fight fellow adventurers in battles to the death in huge underground caverns.
extra.group_reward_bespoke: You performance in deathmatch will award <col=ffffff>Deathmatch Points</col> which may be exchanged for various titles, death sound effects or in-game items.

extra.worldmap_upsell_content_text: Sunlight doesn't reach Morytania. It is in perpetual darkness. This has drawn vampyres, werewolves, ghouls and ghosts to its lands, and humans are nothing more than prey.

For those venturing into the desert, discover the story of the desert gods including Icthlarin, the god of the Underworld, and Amascut, the Devourer. To the south is the golden city of Menaphos, a city of wonder and opportunity... for those who can enter.
Catch a ferry from Port Sarim, and you'll reach Brimhaven. Here, pirates ply their trade - if you can call smuggling, murdering and hijacking a 'trade'.
If you're heading to the Feldip Hills, bring your biggest sword. This is ogre country, and few - if any - have survived to reach the centre of Gu'Tanoth, where the ogre shamans rule.
extra.worldmap_upsell_content_bp0_text: Take the best mudbath in Gielinor

extra.worldmap_upsell_content_text: Tirannwn is the home of the elves. Where other races fight and bicker, the elves keep to themselves. Should you manage to gain their trust, however, you will be welcomed into a land of stunning beauty.

Kandarin is almost twice the size of any other continent, and comes with its fair share of cities, including Ardougne and the Tree Gnome Village. It also has its share of conflict, with humans and gnomes at loggerheads.
The Fremennik are a barbarian race, hardy enough to survive in the tundra. Rellekka is their capital, and they gather in longhalls to sing of their victories.
extra.worldmap_upsell_content_bp1_text: Become King or Queen of your own island

extra.worldmap_upsell_content_text: Only nefarious, double-crossing pirates find their way to Mos Le'Harmless. They have to be knocked out beforehand, however, so that they can never quite recall how they got there.
The monkeys and apes of Ape Atoll know how to have a good time. Under the auspices of their goddess, Marimbo, they live free and party hard.
The trolls thrive in the frozen north, where they are rarely at peace. They fight bloody wars on two fronts: against the dwarves of Keldagrim, and the humans of Burthorpe.
extra.worldmap_upsell_content_bp2_text: Fight Nex, one of the toughest bosses

extra.bslay_tactic_text: The Sanctum Guardian will dive down into the water and re-emerge with a large splash. This deals <col=FFFFFF>crush</col> damage to you if you are within range of it.
The Sanctum Guardian slowly spins around while launching a continuous torrent of water around the room.

A player will be corrupted with shadowy energy and, after a short time, release a patch of shadowy flame beneath their current location. Standing in the shadowy flame will cause you to take large amounts of damage.
The Sanctum Guardian may occasionally summon addition Crassians to assist her.
Masuta summons spiritual shadow clones to take his opponents by surprise with a vicious kick. This deals high <col=FFFFFF>melee</col> damage and is more deadly the further away the target.
Masuta spins with blade outstretched, causing increasingly brutal <col=FFFFFF>melee</col> damage. He becomes briefly immune to damage and cures himself of any bleed effects upon using this ability.

extra.task_name: World Event: The Bird and the Beast
extra.task_details: Two mighty gods have returned to Gielinor and are engaged in a titanic arms race. Help your chosen god to achieve victory!
extra.task_step_1: Talk to Kara-Meir north of Falador.

You can now make shimmering honeycomb from Golden Roses.

extra.potion_info_custom_text: For the next hour, the followers of Bandos in the God Wars Dungeon will not attack you.

Tier 70 hybrid foot armour from the Hanto isle.
