extra.pop_voyage_text: The Trapper wishes to practice firing Ol' Bessie at far off targets. Take him to the Isle of Juniper and find an open area.
Tattanogi is rumoured to have a plant that has a unique flavour. The Chef wants to experiment with it in recipes.
The Architect wants to study the architecture of various buildings around Tokoko. Help her discover new designs.
The Trapper wishes to learn more from the Assassin. Have him observe her stealthy skills at the pirate ports of Kei Pi.
The Chef wants to know more about the animals on the Isle of Juniper. The Biologist can help.
The Missionary can spread the word of Saradomin to Tattanogi. The Architect can design places of worship.
Tally ho! The Trapper has heard of a source of pearls and koi near the Isle of Juniper. Help him find some.
The Chef wants to try to replace salt and pepper with ground pearls and spices. Help him get some.
The Architect has received word of a source of beautiful koi scales and pearls. Help her recover them.
The Trapper and Assassin have uncovered information regarding a stockpile of pearls and scales. Help them recover some.
The Chef and Biologist have a lead on a good source of pearls and spices. Help them claim some.
The Architect and the Missionary have heard of a merchant willing to trade koi scales and pearls for assistance. Assist.
The Trapper has been told of a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. It is rumoured to be in some ruins. Help him recover the piece.
The Chef knows the location of a piece of a forgotten scroll. He will attempt to barter for it with one of his cooking techniques.
The Architect has received word that a wealthy trader is looking for help with a project. Barter for a rare scroll he has in exchange for her help.
Tally ho! The Trapper saw some jade while on an expedition. Go help him collect it.
The Chef has heard of a new cooking utensil - the jade pestle and mortar, said to make grinding easier. Help him investigate the claims.
Jade makes for a great centrepiece. Help the Architect gather some.
The Trapper and Assassin have heard of a source of jade in the hands of the pirate leader of the Pins. Help the pair recover some.
The Chef and Biologist have heard of some jade near Tattanogi. Help the duo fetch it.
The Architect and Missionary have located a stockpile of jade in the hands of Zamorakian zealots. Help them locate and recover the supplies.
A small raider band is making itself a nuisance to shipping around the Lair of Tavi and Vynal. Capture their ships, and sell them second-hand.
Make improved maps of the Island that is Blamed for Nothing, to help save the lives of future adventurers visiting the place.
Explore the Island that is Blamed for Nothing in search of new azure deposits. Beware of the treacherous landscape, which deceives.
A ship from Rei Ti seeks an escort to the Isle of Adamant. They will give you a cut of their profits if successful.
The fabled Lightning Ray has been sighted in the waters off Bladewing Crag. Hunt the beast for fame and glory.
The Clinging Sands have arisen once more in the Tengu Archipelago. Drive it off lest the entire island chain be consumed.
Word has reached your navigator that the Seven Great Toads are rampaging across the Island that is Blamed for Nothing. Force them back into the sea.
The terrible beast known as the Spinning Octopus has been drawn to the Lair of Tavi and Vynal in search of food. Persuade it to search elsewhere.
The people of the Lair of Tavi and Vynal have refined tastes. A trade mission to the island could be richly rewarding.
The khanate spymasters of the Arc want the population of the Isle of Adamant spied on. That much wealth could buy a lot of unrest.
An azure-mining operation on Bladewing Crag could prove profitable, if it can be adequately defended while it operates.
The miners on Bladewing Crag pay a premium for otherwise-cheap goods they cannot obtain themselves. Send a trade delegation to investigate.
The gargantuan, ancient golem known as the Obsidian Weapon is laying waste to the Isle of Adamant. Destroy it before it's too late.
The shallows around Bladewing Crag may prove a suitable location to shallow-dive in search of loose azure. Send a crew to investigate.
The shallows around the Island that is Blamed for Nothing may prove a suitable location to shallow-dive in search of loose azure. Send a crew to investigate.
The mining outfit owners on the Isle of Adamant want the Bladewing Crag operations disrupted. Be sure to fly pirate colours to disguise yourself.
Bladewings are flocking in unusual numbers and migrating to the Lair of Tavi and Vynal. Innocent lives are at risk if we do not act.
A notable metallurgist from Ardougne is interested in assaying the quality of the adamant deposits on the Isle of Adamant, and will pay for passage.
Sign a treaty with the leader of the Obsidian pirates of the Tengu Archipelago. It will grant some respite, until they inevitably betray us.
Blazing Lantern pirates from the west are battling Obsidian pirates near the Lair of Tavi and Vynal. Await your chance and engage the winner.
Smuggle a shipment of azure off Bladewing Crag and return it to port without any of the Arc's bureaucrats learning of the transfer.
Smuggle a shipment of azure off the Island that is Blamed for Nothing and return it to port without any of the Arc's bureaucrats learning of the transfer.
Discover a safer trade route between Kei Pi and the Lair of Tavi and Vynal, improving commerce between the two regions.
No ship has yet successfully navigated the shoals to the west of Bladewing Crag. Could one of yours be the first to perform the feat?
A dying sailor entrusted one of your cabin boys with what seems to be an old treasure map. Send a ship to the Tengu Archipelago to follow it.
A notorious pirate, Lanjahn the Slaver, has established a successful operation preying on the Lair of Tavi and Vynal. Go and shiver his timbers for him.
Rumour claims that a rogue seasinger is raising an army of denizens of the deep to conquer the Tengu Archipelago. Show her that this behaviour is wrong.
An azure-mining operation on the Isle of Adamant could prove profitable, if it can be adequately defended while it operates.
Establish diplomatic contact with the sensei of the ninja musicians of the Lair of Tavi and Vynal. She should be a valuable ally.
The mine foreman of the Island that is Blamed for Nothing has posted a bounty on a ronin ogre who has set up camp on the outskirts of the mother lode.
Intercede in a fight between sea orphan miners and nomad raiders within the Tengu Archipelago.
A musician couple from the Lair of Tavi and Vynal have been visiting the West and now wish to return home. They offer payment, and a free concert.
The leaders at the Lair of Tavi and Vynal wish to set up a diplomatic delegation on Flou Tar-Shei. Assist them with transport and protection.
Your agents have heard of an imminent trade between azure-miners on the Isle of Adamant and a pirate crew. Get there first and take their place.
Your agents have heard of an imminent trade between azure-miners on Bladewing Crag and a pirate crew. Get there first and take their place.
Cull the bird population of Bladewing Crag to protect the lives of the few stalwart miners of the region. Take whatever you find in the lairs as a sweetener.
A fortress of sea raiders overlooks the people of the Island that is Blamed for Nothing. Besiege it, reduce it to rubble, then loot the place.
The musicians of the Lair of Tavi and Vynal have sent a message offering a tribute of lacquer. Accept, gracefully.
The topmost spires of Bladewing Crag have begun to crackle with chi. Send a nimble crew to climb the rocks and bring home the goods.
Pirates in the Tengu Archipelago are holding on to a trove of spices taken from a recent conquest. Reclaim it from them, and keep it.
On the Island that is Blamed for Nothing, a mining colony has come into possession of a cache of pearls which they will turn over to you for protection.
The koi are swarming in large numbers off the coast of the Isle of Adamant. Travel there and gather what you can.
Rumours have reached your ears regarding an unexplored island known as Exile's Point. The opportunity beckons to add a chance of attracting the rare Kharidian Exile to your crew.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Tengu Archipelago.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Isle of Adamant.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to The Lair of Tavi and Vynal.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Island that is Blamed for Nothing.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Spires of Grief.
Capture a fortified sea bastion belonging to the Mainland Ambassador, near the coasts of Dhar Pei's Vantage. It will be a useful asset.
Smuggle weapons belonging to a local khan to his forces within Dhar Pei's Vantage. Ensure you aren't caught by the authorities.
Spy on the Mainland Ambassador and deliver information to the spymaster in Yaonai City.
Maintain a siege on the Bubble of Mists, located in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl. Make sure you're flying a rival's colours.
Sabotage the ships docked in the grand port at Yaonai City to ensure we remain competitive.
The Deep Plunderer has been spotted near the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. Fight the beast for fame and glory.
Befriend the Mainland Ambassador's daughter, stationed near Dhar Pei's Vantage, who may well prove to be a useful ally.
Maintain a siege on the Spires of Grief, in the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. Make sure you're flying a rival's colours.
A ship from the Spires of Grief needs an escort to Khanoka. They assure us they can pay, and pay well.
Pirates on the edge of the Straits of the Oyster Pearl believe their base is securely hidden. Teach them otherwise, and take their stuff.
A raider band has designs on a township on the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. Stop them; the townsmen will be grateful.
The Straits of the Oyster Pearl are known for their fierce currents as much as their pearls. A concerted mapping effort may save lives.
The Bubble of Mists, in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl, has put out a general call for crews. This may be an opportunity for gain.
Explore the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers in search of resources. Beware of the skingliders that infest the outskirts.
The Spires of Grief, in the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers, has put out a general call for crews. This may be an opportunity for gain.
A vast purple beast, rimed with ice, is wreaking havoc in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl. Drive it away before more lives are lost.
The Lazing Armadillo has fallen asleep across a major channel of the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. 'Gently persuade' it to leave.
The golem twins known as the Terracotta Men are blockading Dhar Pei's Vantage. Drive them off and save the island.
A group of sea orphans exiled from the western island groups have asked for your assistance in reaching Dhar Pei's Vantage. They can pay.
The known routes across the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers are treacherous. Can your crew do a better job of surveying the place?
A village in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl has asked for your help in driving off an imminent skinglider attack.
A ship local to Dhar Pei's Vantage was caught in a magnetic storm and its compass scrambled; now they've gone north instead of south. Help them back on course.
An expedition to Dhar Pei's Vantage from Ardougne has encountered serious difficulties. Help them out before it's too late.
Trouble has arisen at a meeting between representatives of Ren Bo and Dhar Pei's Vantage. Get out there and keep the peace.
A sickness afflicting magically-able children has taken hold of Dhar Pei's Vantage. Send a medical expedition to assist.
The Not Beast has risen from the sea between Dhar Pei's Vantage and the Bubble of Mists. Drive it back to the depths before it's too late.
Dhar Pei's Vantage is notorious for accidental shipwrecks off its coast. Survey the area to improve the shipping lanes.
Explore the seas south of the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers in search of immortal glory; failing that, in search of loot.
A pirate lord from the outskirts of Dhar Pei's Vantage has offered his fealty to you. Send a delegation to accept the alliance.
A pirate lord in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl has made an insulting demand for your fealty. Teach her some manners.
Villages on the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers are being plagued by giant coral terrapins. Helping them is right, and profitable.
A ship from the Bubble of Mists needs an escort to Flou Tar-Shei. They will show their gratitude with a cut of their profits.
A village on the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers has asked for your help in driving off an imminent yoma attack.
Meet with the leader of the city known as the Bubble of Mists, in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl, to discuss trading rights in the Loop.
Meet with the leader of the city known as the Spires of Grief, in the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers, to discuss trading rights in the Loop.
Rumour has it that the skingliders who live in the depths under the Loop have piles of ancient bones stashed in their caves. This seems promising.
A renowned pirate armoursmith and her personal stock of plate are being transported from Kei Pi to the Spires of Grief. See she doesn't get there.
Your spies report that a heavily locked and well guarded box of goods is being held by terracotta golems in the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers.
A strange well of chi has opened up within the waters of the Loop. Send a ship to claim as much as possible before this source dries up.
A merchant in Dhar Pei's Vantage, in gratitude for previous aid, has offered you an excellent deal on a small stash of top-quality spices.
A pearl-harvesters' village in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl is being extorted by pirates from further east. Help them out; they'll be grateful.
An anonymous tip has revealed that stonescale koi are swarming in huge numbers in the vicinity of Dhar Pei's Vantage. There's profit to be made if you hurry.
Rumours have reached your ears regarding an unexplored island known as Light Under Sea. The opportunity beckons to add a chance of attracting a wisp to your crew.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Bubble of Mists.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Spires of Grief.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to Yaonai City.
Your captain has the opportunity to unlock an innate ability by journeying to the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers.
Tally ho! The Trapper saw some bamboo while on an expedition. Go help him collect it.
The Chef tried to cook bamboo. It didn't taste good, but we can use it around port. Go help him collect some.
The Architect is willing to show your crew where her town gets some of its bamboo.
The Trapper and the Assassin know of a bamboo field guarded by animals. These two have the skills to get to it.
The Biologist knows where bamboo can be found; The Chef can smell it a mile away.
The Missionary and the Architect have heard bamboo is being stockpiled by zealots. They feel it would be better used in port.
An opportunity has arisen to trade with a shadowy trader, somewhere on Tattanogi, for pearls.
There is a bounty on a local pirate lord. Bring his head to the khan of Tokoko to claim the bounty.
The Biologist believes that there's important knowledge to be had at Dhar Pei's Vantage by studying the feeding habits of the long-toothed kyatt. Help the Biologist uncover their secrets.
The Whaler believes that there's much to be learned from fish that inhabit The Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. Help the Whaler study them.
The Assassin thinks there's a chance to practice her craft at a village on the Straits of the Oyster Pearl. Help the Assassin practice her craft.
The Convict thinks there are opportunities for perfecting his trade on Dhar Pei's Vantage. There are a lot of stalls on which to hone his abilities.
The Occultist wishes to obtain the secrets of the magical coral in the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. They seem charged with energy. Studying this coral will impart powerful knowledge.
The Missionary believes that there's ample opportunity for practicing his calling at Dhar Pei's Vantage. There are liars and cheats, and other men of vice who need to hear the word of Saradomin.
The Trapper wishes to practice firing Ol' Bessie at far-off targets. Take him to Dhar Pei's Vantage and hunt a few things.
The Straits of the Oyster Pearl are rumoured to have a fish that has a unique flavour. The Chef wants to experiment with it in recipes.
The Architect wants to study the architecture of various buildings around Dhar Pei's Vantage. Help her discover new designs.
The Biologist and the Whaler have uncovered a new species of shark. It appears to swim upside down. The two of them wish to join forces to hunt and study them.
The Assassin and Convict wish to hone their techniques at Dhar Pei's Vantage. There's plenty of opportunity to practice thievery and contract killing, and to learn from each other.
The Missionary and Occultist wish to dive in The Reef that Lies to Mapmakers to study the magical properties that cause confusion to sailors.
The Trapper wishes to learn more from the Assassin. Have him observe her stealthy skills at Dhar Pei's Vantage.
The Chef wants to know more about the coral in the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. The Biologist can help.
The Missionary can spread the word of Saradomin to the Straits of the Oyster Pearl. The Architect can design places of worship.
The Biologist believes she knows the location of a supply of ancient bones. Help her navigate The Reef that Lies to Mapmakers.
The Whaler knows of a wreck of a ship that was transporting plate. Help him retrieve it from The Reef that Lies to Mapmakers.
The Assassin has heard that the khan of the Straits of the Oyster Pearl has surplus spice. Help her 'take' it from him.
The Convict has heard of a vault in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl's palace that contains a healthy amount of lacquer. Help him break into it.
The Occultist understands that there's magical energy within the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. Help her find it.
Praise Saradomin! The Missionary knows of a source of ancient bones on Dhar Pei's Vantage. Help him claim them.
Tally ho! The Trapper has heard of a source of pearls and koi near the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. Help him find some.
The Chef wants to try make a new dessert with pearls and spices. It probably won't go well. At least help him get some ingredients.
The Architect has received word of a source of beautiful koi scales and pearls. Help her recover them.
The Whaler and the Biologist have tracked down a big surplus of plate in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl. Their knowledge of sea creatures is essential to retrieving these resources.
The Assassin and Convict report that the khan of the Straits of the Oyster Pearl is transporting a huge shipment of lacquer on his ship. Help the duo secure the resource.
The Missionary and Occultist have felt a magical disturbance near The Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. This magical energy can be used to uncover a source of chi.
The Trapper and Assassin have uncovered information regarding a stockpile of pearls and koi scales. Help them recover some.
The Chef and Biologist have a lead on a good source of pearls and spices. Help them claim some.
The Architect and the Missionary have heard of a merchant willing to trade koi scales and pearls for assistance. Assist.
The Barmaid has heard some interesting gossip concerning Dhar Pei's Vantage and a shipment of terracotta.

The Biologist thinks she's uncovered a rare piece of a forgotten scroll in the forest near Dhar Pei's Vantage. Swooping roc make the area dangerous. Her knowledge will prove invalulable on this voyage.
The Whaler has tracked down a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. It is located near the habitat of the fearsome Left-Clawed Crab. His experience will be essential for success.
The Assassin has located a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. However, it's being held by a merchant in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl. Eliminate him. The Assassin's deadly skills will be pivotal.

The Convict has been informed that a rare piece of a forgotten scroll is in the safe of a Dhar Pei's Vantage warlord. Help him infiltrate the building and crack the safe. His skills will prove vital for success.

The Occultist has tracked down a rare piece of a forgotten scroll, but it is protected by magic. Head to The Reef that Lies to Mapmakers, decode the ancient spell that protects it and take the scroll. Her magical prowess will be an essential asset on this voyage.

The Missionary has heard that a rare piece of a forgotten scroll has fallen into the hands of a Zarosian priestess preaching on Dhar Pei's Vantage. Help him whip up a frenzy, disrupt the sermon, and take the scroll. His fast tongue and swift hand will prove crucial.
The Trapper has been told of a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. It is within the territory of some ferocious creatures. Help him recover the piece.
The Chef knows the location of a piece of a forgotten scroll. He will judge a cooking contest in exchange for the scroll.
The Architect's contacts in the Loop have uncovered what might be a forgotten scroll piece. Get her to the meeting point.
The Biologist believes she knows the location of a supply of terracotta. Help her evade giant voles and claim it.
The Whaler knows of a chest full of terracotta that's sunk to the bottom of the Ocean. Help him retrieve it.
The Assassin has heard that the khan of Dhar Pei's Vantage's seasinger has a vast supply of terracotta, help her 'take' it from him.
The Convict knows of a safe in the Straits of the Oyster Pearl, deep underground that is full of terracotta. Help him break into it.
The Occultist understands that there are resources near the Reef. Help her obtain them.
Praise Saradomin! The Missionary knows of a source of terracotta near a newly established temple of Zaros. Help him claim them.
Tally ho! The Trapper saw some terracotta while on an expedition. Go help him collect it.
The Chef has heard that terracotta pots are great for drink storage. Help him study this claim and gather some supplies.
Terracotta can be used for tiling, both inside and outside a building. Help the Architect recover some.
The Whaler and the Biologist have tracked down a big surplus of terracotta in the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. Their knowledge of sea creatures is essential to retrieving these resources.
The Assassin and Convict report that the khan of Dhar Pei's Vantage is transporting a huge shipment of terracotta. Help the duo secure the resource.
The Missionary and Occultist have felt a magical disturbance near the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. This magical energy can be used to uncover a source of terracotta.
The Trapper and Assassin have heard of a source of terracotta in a storage building near the Reef that Lies to Mapmakers. Help the pair recover some.
The Chef and Biologist have heard of some terracotta near Dhar Pei's Vantage. Help the duo fetch it.
The Architect and Missionary have located a stockpile of terracotta. Help the pair recover the goods.
The Trapper wishes to practice firing Ol' Bessie at far off targets. Take him to the Fistmarks of Genma and find an open area.
The Earthquake Straits are rumoured to have a herb that has a unique flavour. The Chef wants to experiment with it in recipes.
The Architect wants to study the architecture of various buildings around the Earthquake Straits. Help her discover new designs.
The Trapper wishes to study the stealthy techniques of the Assassin. She has selected a target on Rei Ti.
The Chef wants to try and cook a snapper drake. The Biologist knows where they can be found on Rei Ti.
The Missionary is heading out to speak at a recently built church of Saradomin on Rei Ti. The Architect is joining him to survey the site and ensure the structure is sturdy enough.
Tally ho! The Trapper has heard of a source of pearls near the Bay of Playful Sirens. Help him find a record-breaking one.
The Chef once tried to use pearls to decorate a cake. It didn't end well. Help him find some replacement pearls.
The Architect has received word of a source of beautiful koi scales. Help her recover them.
The Trapper and Assassin have uncovered information regarding a stockpile of pearls. Help them recover some.
The Chef and Biologist have a lead on a good source of pearls. Help them claim some.
The Architect and the Missionary have heard of a merchant willing to trade koi scales for assistance. Assist.
The Trapper has been told of a rare piece of a forgotten scroll. It is rumoured to be in an abandoned mine filled with massive bats. Help him recover the piece.
The Chef knows the location of a piece of a forgotten scroll. He will attempt to barter for it with one of his famous meals.
The Architect has heard of a trader willing to trade a piece of a forgotten scroll for assistance. Go now before someone else claims the scroll.
Tally ho! The Trapper saw some slate while on an expedition. Go help him collect it.
The Chef has heard of a new baking technique involving a slate-lined oven. Let him study and pick up some supplies.
Slate can be used to great effect in construction of buildings. Help the Architect locate some.
The Trapper and Assassin have heard of a source of slate on Rapa Causeway. Help the pair recover some.
The Chef and Biologist have heard of some slate in the Dead Khan's Sea. Help the duo fetch it.
The Architect and Missionary have located a stockpile of slate near Rei Ti. Help them collect some.
You hear that a fort belonging to a foul necromancer is vulnerable. An attack could make the area around the Scythe safer for all.
Trade routes are under attack at the Jade Straits. Fight off the swarming foul-stinged rays to protect the routes.
Pearl divers from the Loop, shipwrecked near Flou Tar-Shei, need rescuing from the shark menace.
Koi are native to areas further east, but today they are present near New Heritage. Gather them while you may.
A wealthy gentleman has commissioned an expedition to discover new hunting grounds.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The crew have reported finding new hunting grounds for the wealthy gentleman.

extra.pop_voyage_text: A crew reports that they may have spotted someone stranded on an isle on the return leg of their last voyage, but were running low on supplies. It might be worth having another look.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The crew have recovered a chef, who has been making them exquisite meals. He was alone on an island for some time, apparently.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Investigate a recent earthquake on Waiko Island.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Lidylla, an architect, has returned with your crew and she is seeking help.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Trapper is ready to head out for the hunt!
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Trapper has come back with a tale to tell…

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Chef needs to collect some ingredients for his 'perfect dish'.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Chef has brought back many barrels of supplies. He seems to have found his exotic ingredient.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Lidylla the Architect needs to return to the Eastern Lands for further study.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Architect has returned to port with new information.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Trapper has heard of an elusive creature that has never been caught before. How can he resist?
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Trapper encountered a hunting party while on his adventure. They had an odd tale to tell…

extra.pop_voyage_text: Some odd reports have been coming in from the crew. They have been taken ill, and many have not turned up for work. Further investigation is required.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Chef returned the barrels of herbs to the island. When he got there, the population of toxic plants had disappeared!

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Architect has heard word of a material that might help save her town.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Lidylla has recovered some of the material, but has bad news.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Reginald Wellington-Smythe wants to gather more information on the camouflaged creature that was being trailed by the hunting party.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Trapper has returned with a tall tale.

extra.pop_voyage_text: You've received reports of a remote village that has stockpiled the toxic plant. It's a race against time to make sure they don't eat it!
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The villagers appear well and are not eating the plant. However, a party left earlier with the intention of trading the barrels with a nearby village.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Word has come from the East. A discovery has been made in Lidylla's hometown.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Lidylla has studied the material.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Trapper wishes to go hunting for the vanishing beast or beasts.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Trapper and the assigned hunting party have returned. Are they empty handed?

extra.pop_voyage_text: The party with the plant barrels has been spotted. The Chef is on hand to save them.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Chef tracked down the party, but does not have good news…

extra.pop_voyage_text: The Architect wants to visit the location where the sample was collected.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Lidylla has made a curious discovery while hunting for the material needed to save her town.

extra.pop_voyage_text: After studying the evidence, the Trapper has come up with a theory concerning the creature.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Trapper has the evidence he needs regarding the mysterious creature.

extra.pop_voyage_text: After the gruesome discovery, the chef wants to investigate the incident further.

extra.bslay_tactic_text: Seiryu's tail slams down and creates a shadowy portal through which it attacks the players directly beneath their feet.
The Black Stone Crystals on Seiryu's back emit a trail of grasping shadowy hands that move across the arena and deal significant damage.

Once Seiryu is incapacitated, the crystals open a portal from which a large hand made of black stone appears. Formless shadowy blobs called Shadow Enigmas pour out from the portal and are immediately drawn to Seiryu's head. If they reach Seiryu, they <col=FFFFFF>heal</col> the Black Stone Crystals for a great deal of lifepoints.

Powerful celestial dragons can phase through dimensional space, and thus Astellarn takes greatly reduced damage as she is able to mitigate direct hits. Standing in a stabilised <col=FFFFFF>Wyrmhole</col> will balance out this effect however.
Cosmic rain particles will fall on random quadrants in the arena, causing increased <col=FFFFFF>typeless</col> damage over time.

In each corner of the graveyard are long-dead, preserved beasts. After the disruption caused from Croesus, these buried creatures have been uncovered and are a perfect resource for Croesus's fungus to grow. Remove the fungus from these to weaken Croesus and gather useful resources. Be vigilant - removed fungus will eventually grow back and strengthen Croesus again. Use rotten fungus to create a poisonous paste that can slow down the regrowth.

extra.bslay_tactic_text: Astellarn will occasionally summon a Pulsar, which will continuously pulse for damage until destroyed.

A Neutron Star will appear and gravitate towards a player in Astellarn's arena. If it comes into contact with the player it will explode for significant damage. Neutron Stars may be dragged into <col=FFFFFF>Wyrmholes</col> in order to stabilise them. Once stabilised, Wyrmholes will significantly increase the damage of anyone standing in them instead of dealing damage.

Astellarn will select a player on which to anchor a Wyrmhole. The player has a short period of time to position themselves before a Wyrmhole spawns on top of them. The Wyrmhole will deal small amounts of damage to anyone stood in or near it.
Verak Lith summons spires that rise up from the ground beneath his opponents. These deal immediate damage and they grant Verak Lith <col=FFFFFF>invulnerability</col> while they are present.

extra.bslay_tactic_title: Elements of the King Black Dragon
extra.bslay_tactic_text: Verak Lith will launch elemental energy projectiles into the air of either poison, ice or electrical energy. If these energies hit the ground, they will cause significant damage to any players in the arena. It is therefore recommended to catch the projectiles and use nearby dragon eggs of the respective elemental type to disperse the energy instead. Clever use of defensive abilities will also work.
Throughout the encounter, black dragons will dive bomb your location, leaving a trail of dangerous ice, shock or poison energy that deals large amount of damage.
Verak Lith summons a patch of unstable fire, which explodes outwards into multiple flame vortices. These deal significant damage to anyone near them.
A shadowy breath attack that deals <col=FFFFFF>magic</col> damage to anyone caught in it.
The Black Stone Dragon sends out gemstone shards at all opponents, puncturing her targets for <col=FFFFFF>melee</col> damage, stealing their lifepoints, and completely draining their adrenaline.

Once she has taken some damage, the Black Stone Dragon will become shackled by four Black Hands in the centre of the arena. These Black Hands will launch <col=FFFFFF>magic</col> projectiles at the player, and occasionally slam the ground, causing shadowy grasping hands to move towards the location of their target.

extra.cheevo_details: The Barrows Brothers are ancient warriors that are truly dedicated to combat. Led by Ahrim, each brother has their own fighting style to challenge you as you make your way towards a chest containing your loot.

extra.bslay_name: The Barrows: Rise of the Six
extra.cheevo_details: An enhanced version of the original Barrows. This time the brothers are fighting in unison, using the environment to their advantage. Choose your team mates wisely before entering the empowered entrance, or else you might not make it out alive.

Wandering deep in the Wilderness is this strange creature. It uses all kinds of meddlesome magic to confuse you and ensure that you won't leave the Wilderness without at least putting up a fight first.
Leader of the Saradominist army, the icyene known as Zilyana uses powerful magic and melee attacks to silence her victims.
This beast resides in a dungeon within the Wilderness. It will devour any familiar you bring, and has strong magic attacks.
Situated deep in the caves of Waterbirth island, reside the three Dagannoth Kings, each using a different combat style.
Leader of the slain Bandos's army, General Graardor is a powerful ourg with a strong melee attack.
Not quite as fluffy as you might imagine, the Giant Mole uses its surroundings to put up a fight against anything you throw at it.
Coated in lava, Har-Aken requires immense endurance to reach, and even more to defeat.
Deep in the Exiled Kalphite Hive lies the Kalphite King. With an army in his service, you're entering into a fight which may not have a happy ending.
The queen of the kalphites, surrounded by the protection of her army. Be prepared for her change in form or accept your fate.
Residing deep in the Wilderness is the three-headed king of the dragons.
Kree'arra, one of Armadyl's most trusted generals, is a huge aviansie that uses his wings to - quite literally - blow you away.
Commanding the Zamorakian army, K'ril powers through your prayers, leaving you in a vulnerable state of attack for his minions and himself.
Created by Ocellus, the legiones are equipped with Guthixian magic, punishing those who let their guard down.
All the way from Freneskae, Nex uses her Zarosian powers to cripple unworthy opponents. Enter her prison at your own risk.

The first dragon ever created, the Queen Black Dragon is enormous! Her terrifying roar and incinerating breath will surely stop you in your tracks. Players that have completed the quest 'Song from the Depths' may find they have an easier time surviving against her.

TzTok-Jad can be fought in the Fight Caves or the Fight Kiln - if you can survive long enough to see it, that is. Armed with very strong attacks, you'd better pray that it doesn't end you before you receive your reward.

If you dare challenge this mighty warrior of the earth, you'll have a real fight on your hands. One of the toughest creatures in all of Gielinor, you don't want to enter this fight without a solid team.

extra.bslay_tactic_text: The Ambassador will occasionally conjure unstable energy portals from Erebus. These Unstable black holes increase in energy over time and explode for huge <col=FFFFFF>typeless</col> damage if not interrupted by a stun ability.

Kranon will unleash a huge and continuous burst of energy that will disintegrate anything it hits with huge typeless damage. He will channel and rotate three large beams around the room in an attempt to annihilate any players in the arena.

Upon channelling his Tri Beam, <col=FFFFFF>6</col> Sinister Fragments of the Ambassador's power fly out of him and are exposed and vulnerable. Destroying as many of these as possible is recommended to prevent him from reabsorbing them.
The Ambassador will cause massive shockwaves after finishing his Tri Beam attack. He is able of unleashing one shockwave for every Sinister Fragment that was reabsorbed.
Kranon will start to summon <col=FFFFFF>invulnerable</col> Crassians to assist him.

After appearing at the side of the arena, Seiryu will <col=FFFFFF>fully heal</col> all players and use a <col=FFFFFF>Deep Breath</col> attack to destroy the Crassians.

In his fury, Kranon decides to call upon Xau-Tak for the final phase of the fight. This causes 12 Black Hands to appear and they immediate begin projecting dark magic towards Kranon in order to heal him and empower him.

It is possible to intercept the projectiles, causing minor typeless damage to yourself instead of allowing them to heal the Ambassador.

extra.bslay_tactic_text: Orikalka will smash the ground with her tail and create three fissures. Standing in the vicinity of the rumbling fissures will deal <col=FFFFFF>melee crush</col> damage. If the player is afflicted with the <col=FFFFFF>Frostbite</col> debuff, the fissures will grant the <col=FFFFFF>Pyroclastic Shock</col> effect, rapidly increasing their adrenaline and removing the <col=FFFFFF>Frostbite</col> effects.

Rathis will occasionally spit out a couple of poisonous, acidic orbs which splash onto the ground below, dealing <col=FFFFFF>ranged</col> damage. Standing in the acid will apply the <col=FFFFFF>Corrosion</col> debuff, causing you to take more damage.

Rathis will occasionally roar and absorb any poisonous acid pools on the floor around her. These will significantly <col=FFFFFF>heal</col> her and increase her damage capabilities, unless someone else absorbs the pools first.

Whenever Nex successfully attacks you, you gain a stacking debuff which signifies how angry she is with you. This effect will begin to negatively affect your defensive capabilities if you allow it to reach high levels.
If Nex is tanked too close to a single elemental pillar for too long, she will begin to rapidly gain Enrage stacks.

Nex will shift her focus to one of the four pillars in the arena and then jumps to the centre of the arena, landing and dealing moderate damage to any players in her vicinity.
After landing, she will spawn ice spikes that divide the arena into quadrants. A blood reaver will spawn in each quadrant that Nex isn't targeting.
If there are no targets between Nex and her chosen pillar, Nex will be able to draw full power increasing her Enrage stacks by 20.
If a target remains in the quadrant, then the connection between Nex and her chosen pillar is severed causing the target player to take the force of the elemental pillar.

Blood Reavers spawn and slowly move towards Nex. If they reach her, they will <col=FFFFFF>heal</col> her, and deal <col=FFFFFF>shared damage</col> to all players, for half of their lifepoints, as well as increase her <col=FFFFFF>Enrage</col> effect.
Nex will spawn red orbs on each player's location. They will deal small amounts of damage to anyone stood upon them.

Amalgamations of Smoke, Shadow, Blood and Ice will appear in their respective quadrants. These will give rise to Nex's council of the elements. Umbra, Glacies, Cruor and Fumus will all spawn in a slightly weakened state if their elemental amalgamation is destroyed in time, otherwise they will spawn at full strength.

Nex will pick a number of players to trap in ice. Once the players are trapped, she will summon a large icicle above them. If struck by the falling icicle, the player will take substantial damage as damage over time until the icicle breaks or enough damage is dealt.
Nex will choose two players randomly and launch a wall of smoke in their direction. Anyone caught in the smoke blades will receive significant magic damage.

Occasionally, Nex will cause a black cloud of smoke to spawn in the arena, containing an unstable smoke crystal. If the crystal is left unchecked, it will explode and deal shared damage to all players. Players can group together around the Unstable Smoke to disperse it amongst themselves for lower damage.
After she has been sufficiently weakened, Nex will harness the power of her crystals. She gains <col=FFFFFF>invulnerability</col> from them, but in turn, they become vulnerable to attack.

Nex targets a player and marks them to take the full force of the elements. The player has a limited amount of time to enter the safety of the central dome lest they succumb to the elements and be <col=FFFFFF>instantly killed</col>.

extra.dom_boss_desc:
One of the highest ranking and most powerful Vyres, Vanstrom hated humans with an extraordinary passion and was intent on destroying the Myreque.

Quest: The Branches of Darkmeyer

Combat: As an ancient vampyre, Vanstrom provides a suitably challenging fight for the final boss of a high-level quest. To damage him, you'll need a blisterwood weapon and - later on - holy water. Vanstrom uses melee and magic attacks, as well as some more complex tactics. When Vanstrom plunges the room into darkness, avoid damage by facing fully away from him. If he summons bloodvelds, you must kill them before they reach him, or Vanstrom will be healed. You should also keep an eye out for an explosion of shadow in the centre of the arena. Occasionally, Vanstrom will take off to gain an advantage. Keep moving! Finally, Vanstrom will resort to his vapour form. Flood the area with holy water to take him down.

Trapped in a cave for centuries, Char's anger at Zamorak fuels her to fight. Being a member of the long-lost auspah race, Char commands great power over fire, bending it to her will.

Quest: The Firemaker's Curse

Combat: To take down Char you must fight fire with fire. The damage you inflict relies on how many fires you have lit, so use the pitch can often to ensure your numbers don't fall too low and keep an eye out for Char stamping them out. In her rage, Char will emit sparks which you can lure over your fires for bonuses. When Char becomes furious, avoid being hit! In the later stages of the fight, watch out for her summoned fire walls.

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: Looks like the Lady wants you dead!
extra.dom_boss_desc:
The bodyguards of Lady Keli, Apep and Heru are deadly desert mercenaries.

Quest: Diamond in the Rough

Combat: Apep and Heru must be taken on together, with Apep's presence boosting Heru's power. Avoid being hit by Apep's 'whirling dervish' and run away from Heru when he positions his shield towards you to avoid being blinded.

extra.dom_boss_desc:
A snapshot of the epic battle with Lucien over the Mahjarrat ritual site. Face Khazard, followed by Lucien's minions.

Quest: Ritual of the Mahjarrat

Combat: First, you must face Khazard. While using magic attacks, he will unleash his dog, Bouncer on you. Luckily Wahisietel will join you to destroy Bouncer if you're in his range. With Khazard down, you must face Lucien's ice titans. When encased in ice, struggle to free yourself quickly! Finally, take down Lucien's ice demons while avoiding being trapped by their ice spikes to finish the battle.

A Zamorakian mage who attempted to steal the Wand of Resurrection, but was pursued and defeated before she could get away with it.

Quest: The Death of Chivalry

Combat: Dawn uses her magical abilities to her advantage, casting spells that can knock her opponents away and summoning the dead to assist her in battle. Take down these skeletal warriors first then focus on defeating her.

extra.dom_boss_1_taunt: Begone human. You have no place here.
extra.dom_boss_desc:
Faithful servants of Zamorak, Enakhra and Zemouregal fight with burning passion and hatred.

Quest: The World Wakes

Combat: Consider your priorities when taking on both Mahjarrat at the same time. Enakhra uses magic attacks, and has two special moves in her repertoire. If she begins to drain health, you must hide or interrupt her. If she pins you, you must struggle to be freed. Zemouregal also fights with magic, and he will summon decaying portals. Beware of these as they will drain life from you if you are nearby. They can be avoided or destroyed.

Yelps is back for another beating. He will use his wealth and sneaky cunning to protect himself in battle.

Quest: The Mighty Fall

Combat: Yelps has the ability to perform his 'extra spin for the win' attack, which can inflict high damage. Unlike his previous version of this attack, this one will track you around the arena instead of randomly moving, so keep running! He can also call on hired goons to help beat you up when it looks like things will go badly for him. While they are active, he will take less damage.

The dragon hunters were encountered while trying to save the last white dragon. They are back to extract a little revenge for being beaten.

Quest: One of a Kind

Combat: The dragon hunters attack with melee, magic and ranged. They have some combat abilities that will stun and bind you, as well as cause higher damage than normal. Taking all three of them on in one go will be a challenge.

As a manifestation of the elder god Jas, this enemy is a formidible opponent. Encountered in a twisted mindscape, she will do her best to destroy you.

Quest: One of a Kind

Combat: As a fragment of an elder god, Jas will attack with powerful magic. She has access to magical spells and abilities like Asphixiate which will make fighting her tricky. In addition she will summon 'false users,' who each have powerful abilities.

Riven with insanity, driven by evil, infused with chaos. This duo of dwarves tried to take over Keldagrim and lost, but not without a fight!

Quest: Birthright of the Dwarves

Combat: Expect an extremly hard fight! Grimsson is a powerful warrior in his own right, and can charge you for massive damage and hurl his allies at you. Hreidmar will attack with magic from a distance. He will also summon allies that he can heal, buff and detonate to deal you damage.

Lol is the brother to Morningstar, the troll that tried to crush Burthorpe. He is back for vengeance, having been beaten in his quest to win the Bandosian Kyzaj Tournament.

Quest: The Mighty Fall

Combat: Lol attacks with the highest-tech troll weaponry available: thrown rocks! These rocks are big and heavy enough that they will remain and block your movement. Lol can also make them explode for massive damage.

Nial Swiftfling was a Fremennik warrior, but has been turned into a terrible yeti. He has, however, lost none of his warrior's skill.

Quest: Glorious Memories

Combat: Nial will attack in close combat. At range he will hurl axes with the same accuracy and speed that gained him his last name. As a terrible yeti, he also has the ability to roar with such force that you may be flung back several paces.

extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The unburdened worldbearer tried to find solace, but the songs of the seasingers gave her painful memories.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The memory of Aagi seems unsettled and concerned about something, and wishes to talk to you.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Aagi had a great time having new experiences in Wushanko, but still feels the pull of the divination craters.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Sojobo has caught wind of an oni warlord on the rampage who needs to be swiftly brought to justice!
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Sojobo has brought the oni warlord Obanak to heel. He's off to the bar to celebrate.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The unburdened worldbearer has pondered your words and wishes to tell you something.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The unburdened worldbearer brought down a smuggling operation, but heard no word of other gorajo.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Aagi still feels a pull towards divination craters, and wishes to travel far away from them.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Aagi has renamed herself Kami, thanks to the seasingers, and is starting to form memories from her own experiences.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Shanao has felt that the spirits of his people have been disturbed and need to be laid back to rest.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Shanao has managed to return the spirits of his people to rest. For the time being, at least.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The unburdened worldbearer wishes to apologise for misleading you, and wants to tell you how she came to be here.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The unburdened worldbearer found and met her brother, but he wasn't what she was expecting.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Kami seems to be growing in confidence, and wishes to see more of Wushanko.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: While spending time with Surula's family, Kami connected with a sea creature and felt its sadness.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Sojobo suspects there is more going on and wishes to interrogate the Purists on Ren Bo to get to the truth.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Tengu has learned that his nemesis, Benkei, is behind both the oni uprising and the disturbed sky orphan spirits.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The unburdened worldbearer has misgivings about her last meeting with her brother, and wishes to visit him again.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The unburdened worldbearer discovered that her brother was the one that massacred her tribe, and has fallen back into depression.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Kakashi has discovered that you have been sheltering Kami - he needs dealing with to keep Kami safe.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Kakashi is no longer chasing after Kami, though mostly because she's no longer what he thought she was.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Benkei intends to raid the sky orphan's most sacred temple - Sojobo and Shanao intend to stop him!
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Tengu not only managed to stop Benkei, but his mercy shamed Benkei into changing his allegiance.

extra.pop_voyage_text: The unburdened worldbearer wishes to be the one to bring justice to her brother, but feels incapable of doing so.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The unburdened worldbearer is learning The Way of Gu, and starting to realise her inner strength.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Kami has been agitated by a nasty dream...or vision...and wishes to do something about it.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Kami's vision was worse than she thought. Someone has been killing sea creatures, and she wants to protect them.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Benkei hopes to redeem himself by providing information on Kakashi's plan to attack Paradise!
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: With Benkei's help, the Tengu stalled Kakashi's raid on Paradise...but Kakashi got away.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Send The Memory to Light Under Sea to investigate a new wisp colony that's formed there. The Exile and Tengu shall guard her safety, and treat with the unafilliated seasingers.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The trio witnessed Kakashi draining the life force of many sea creatures, in order to power his new scarecrow weapon.

extra.pop_voyage_name: Gu: Warriors of the Magic Mountain
extra.pop_voyage_text: The Tengu and Memory wish to appeal to the Gu masters for knowledge of Kami-shima. The Exile will meet with Benkei in secret.
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: The Tengu and Memory have learned how to find the island of Kami-shima. The Exile has some bad news about the spy, Benkei.

extra.pop_voyage_text: Head to Kami-shima to stop Davosi from firing his scarecrow weapon and wreaking untold damage to the world!
extra.pop_voyage_success_text: Davosi had been stopped and his scarecrow weapon destroyed! The seasingers and the Gu have returned home, but your three adventurers have taken up residence on Kami-shima, becoming its staunchest guardians!
